entries.title: Mauna Kea is deemed as an ideal astronomical site due to ___.
entries.text: Mauna Kea is deemed as an ideal astronomical site due to ___. [A] its religious implications. 其宗教意涵。 [B] its protective surroundings. 其保护性的周边环境。 [C] its geographical features. [D] its existing infrastructure. 其现有基础设施。 答案 C Mauna Kea is deemed as an ideal astronomical site due to ___.由于___ ， Mauna Kea被认为是一个理想的天文遗址。 [A] its religious implications.其宗教意涵。 [B] its protective surroundings.其保护性的周边环境。 [C] its geographical features. [D] its existing infrastructure.其现有基础设施。 💡 考场思路第二段：峰顶高出地球大部分稠密大气层——地理位置高，是地理特征。

entries.title: The construction of the TMT is opposed by some locals partly because ___.
entries.text: The construction of the TMT is opposed by some locals partly because ___. [A] it may risk ruining their intellectual life. 它可能危及他们的智识生活。 [B] they fear losing control of Mauna Kea. 他们担心失去对莫纳克亚山的控制。 [C] their culture will lose a chance of revival. 他们的文化将失去复兴的机会。 [D] it reminds them of a humiliating history. 答案 D The construction of the TMT is opposed by some locals partly because ___.TMT的建设受到一些当地人的反对，部分原因是___。 [A] it may risk ruining their intellectual life.它可能危及他们的智识生活。 [B] they fear losing control of Mauna Kea.他们担心失去对莫纳克亚山的控制。 [C] their culture will lose a chance of revival.他们的文化将失去复兴的机会。 [D] it reminds them of a humiliating history. 💡 考场思路第三段：a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation——提醒他们曾经主权国家被占领的痛苦历史，即屈辱历史。

entries.title: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that progress in today's astronomy ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that progress in today's astronomy ___. [A] is fulfilling the dreams of ancient Hawaiians. [B] helps spread Hawaiian culture across the world. 有助于将夏威夷文化传播到全世界。 [C] may uncover the origin of Hawaiian culture. 可能揭示夏威夷文化的起源。 [D] will eventually soften Hawaiians' hostility. 最终将缓和夏威夷人的敌意。 答案 A It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that progress in today's astronomy ___.从第5段可以推断，当今天文学的进步___。 [A] is fulfilling the dreams of ancient Hawaiians. [B] helps spread Hawaiian culture across the world.有助于将夏威夷文化传播到全世界。 [C] may uncover the origin of Hawaiian culture.可能揭示夏威夷文化的起源。 [D] will eventually soften Hawaiians' hostility.最终将缓和夏威夷人的敌意。 💡 考场思路第五段：最初带来波利尼西亚人到夏威夷的好奇心，今天激励天文学家探索天空——即现代天文学在实现古代夏威夷人的梦想。

entries.title: The author's attitude toward choosing Mauna Kea as the TMT site is one of ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude toward choosing Mauna Kea as the TMT site is one of ___. [A] severe criticism. 严厉批评。 [B] full approval. [C] passive acceptance. 被动接受。 [D] slight hesitancy. 些许犹豫。 答案 B The author's attitude toward choosing Mauna Kea as the TMT site is one of ___.作者对选择Mauna Kea作为TMT站点的态度是___之一。 [A] severe criticism.严厉批评。 [B] full approval. [C] passive acceptance.被动接受。 [D] slight hesitancy.些许犹豫。 💡 考场思路末段：There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea——作者完全支持建在莫纳克亚山。 核心词汇 primal adj. 原始的 ancestral adj. 祖先的 unsurpassed adj. 无比的 vocal adj. 直言不讳的

entries.title: Robert F. Kennedy is cited because he ___.
entries.text: Robert F. Kennedy is cited because he ___. [A] praised the UK for its GDP. 称赞英国的GDP表现。 [B] identified GDP with happiness. 将GDP与幸福等同。 [C] misinterpreted the role of GDP. 误解了 GDP 的作用。 [D] had a low opinion of GDP. 答案 D Robert F. Kennedy is cited because he ___.Robert F. Kennedy之所以被引用，是因为他___。 [A] praised the UK for its GDP.称赞英国的GDP表现。 [B] identified GDP with happiness.将GDP与幸福等同。 [C] misinterpreted the role of GDP.误解了 GDP 的作用。 [D] had a low opinion of GDP. 💡 考场思路首段：GDP衡量"除了让生活有意义之物以外的一切"——即GDP不能衡量真正重要的东西，说明肯尼迪对GDP评价不高。 逐项分析 [A] 赞扬英国GDP → 无中生有； [B] 把GDP等同于幸福 → 与原文相反； [C] 误解GDP作用 → 相反，他看得准； [D] 对GDP评价不高 → 正确。 核心词汇 flawed adj. 有缺陷的 convert...into 把……转化为 shed light on 阐明 rounded adj. 全面的 budding adj. 初现的 refocus v. 重新聚焦

entries.title: It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that ___. [A] GDP as the measure of success is widely defied in the UK. [B] policymakers in the UK are paying less attention to GDP. 英国决策者对GDP关注减少。 [C] the UK will contribute less to the world economy. 英国对全球经济的贡献将减少。 [D] the UK is reluctant to remold its economic pattern. 英国不愿重塑其经济模式。 答案 A It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that ___.从第2款可以推断出___。 [A] GDP as the measure of success is widely defied in the UK. [B] policymakers in the UK are paying less attention to GDP.英国决策者对GDP关注减少。 [C] the UK will contribute less to the world economy.英国对全球经济的贡献将减少。 [D] the UK is reluctant to remold its economic pattern.英国不愿重塑其经济模式。 💡 考场思路第二段：GDP数据好但1700万人投票脱欧——说明英国民众不认可GDP作为成功的衡量标准。defy = 不认可。

entries.title: Which of the following is true about the recent annual study?
entries.text: Which of the following is true about the recent annual study? [A] It excludes GDP as an indicator. 它将GDP排除在指标之外。 [B] It is sponsored by 163 countries. 它由163个国家赞助。 [C] Its criteria are questionable. 其标准值得质疑。 [D] Its results are enlightening. 答案 D Which of the following is true about the recent annual study?关于最近的年度研究，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] It excludes GDP as an indicator.它将GDP排除在指标之外。 [B] It is sponsored by 163 countries.它由163个国家赞助。 [C] Its criteria are questionable.其标准值得质疑。 [D] Its results are enlightening. 💡 考场思路第三段：study...sheds some light on that question——研究结果有启发性。shed light = enlightening。

entries.title: In the last two paragraphs, the author suggests that ___.
entries.text: In the last two paragraphs, the author suggests that ___. [A] the UK is preparing for an economic boom. 英国正为经济繁荣做准备。 [B] it is essential to consider factors beyond GDP. [C] high GDP foreshadows an economic decline. 高 GDP 预示着经济衰退。 [D] it requires caution to handle economic issues. 处理经济问题需谨慎。 答案 B In the last two paragraphs, the author suggests that ___.在最后两段中，作者建议___。 [A] the UK is preparing for an economic boom.英国正为经济繁荣做准备。 [B] it is essential to consider factors beyond GDP. [C] high GDP foreshadows an economic decline.高 GDP 预示着经济衰退。 [D] it requires caution to handle economic issues.处理经济问题需谨慎。 💡 考场思路末段：policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being...could avoid the forecasted doom——作者认为应超越GDP，关注幸福感等因素。

entries.title: Which of the following is the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following is the best title for the text? [A] Brexit, the UK's Gateway to Well-being. 脱欧：英国通向幸福的门户。 [B] Robert F. Kennedy, a Terminator of GDP. Robert F. Kennedy：GDP的终结者。 [C] High GDP But Inadequate Well-being, a UK Lesson. [D] GDP Figures, a Window on Global Economic Health. GDP 数据：观察全球经济健康的窗口。 答案 C Which of the following is the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Brexit, the UK's Gateway to Well-being.脱欧：英国通向幸福的门户。 [B] Robert F. Kennedy, a Terminator of GDP.Robert F. Kennedy：GDP的终结者。 [C] High GDP But Inadequate Well-being, a UK Lesson. [D] GDP Figures, a Window on Global Economic Health.GDP 数据：观察全球经济健康的窗口。 💡 考场思路全文核心：英国GDP高但幸福感不足，脱欧事件是教训。 核心词汇 well-being n. 幸福感 outcome n. 成果 doom n. 厄运 indicator n. 指标

entries.title: The underlined sentence (Para. 1) most probably shows that the court ___.
entries.text: The underlined sentence (Para. 1) most probably shows that the court ___. [A] made no compromise in convicting McDonnell. 在给麦克唐纳定罪时毫不妥协。 [B] avoided defining the extent of McDonnell's duties. 避免界定麦克唐纳职责的范围。 [C] was contemptuous of McDonnell's conduct. [D] refused to comment on McDonnell's ethics. 拒绝对麦克唐纳的伦理问题置评。 答案 C The underlined sentence (Para. 1) most probably shows that the court ___.划线句子（第 1 段）最有可能表明法院___。 [A] made no compromise in convicting McDonnell.在给麦克唐纳定罪时毫不妥协。 [B] avoided defining the extent of McDonnell's duties.避免界定麦克唐纳职责的范围。 [C] was contemptuous of McDonnell's conduct. [D] refused to comment on McDonnell's ethics.拒绝对麦克唐纳的伦理问题置评。 💡 考场思路holding its nose = 嗤之以鼻。法院虽然推翻了定罪，但对其行为的伦理表示鄙视。 逐项分析 [A] 在定罪上不妥协 → 相反，推翻了定罪； [B] 避免界定职责范围 → 无中生有； [C] 对麦克唐纳行为表示鄙视 → 正确； [D] 拒绝评论伦理 → 相反，明确评论了。 核心词汇 unanimous adj. 一致的 overturn v. 推翻 contemptuous adj. 鄙视的 bribery n. 贿赂 favoritism n. 偏袒 transparency n. 透明度

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, an official act is deemed corruptive only if it involv
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, an official act is deemed corruptive only if it involves ___. [A] concrete returns for gift-givers. [B] sizable gains in the form of gifts. 以礼物形式获得的可观收益。 [C] leaking secrets intentionally. 故意泄露机密。 [D] breaking contracts officially. 正式违约。 答案 A According to Paragraph 4, an official act is deemed corruptive only if it involves ___.根据第4款，只有涉及___的官方行为才被视为腐败行为。 [A] concrete returns for gift-givers. [B] sizable gains in the form of gifts.以礼物形式获得的可观收益。 [C] leaking secrets intentionally.故意泄露机密。 [D] breaking contracts officially.正式违约。 💡 考场思路第四段：proof must be made of concrete benefits——必须有具体利益证明。

entries.title: The court's ruling is based on the assumption that public officials are ___.
entries.text: The court's ruling is based on the assumption that public officials are ___. [A] allowed to focus on the concerns of their supporters. 得以专注于其支持者的关切。 [B] qualified to deal independently with bureaucratic issues. 有资格独立处理官僚事务。 [C] justified in addressing the needs of their constituents. [D] exempt from conviction on the charge of favoritism. 免于因偏袒指控而被定罪。 答案 C The court's ruling is based on the assumption that public officials are ___.法院的裁决基于公职人员是___的假设。 [A] allowed to focus on the concerns of their supporters.得以专注于其支持者的关切。 [B] qualified to deal independently with bureaucratic issues.有资格独立处理官僚事务。 [C] justified in addressing the needs of their constituents. [D] exempt from conviction on the charge of favoritism.免于因偏袒指控而被定罪。 💡 考场思路第五段：public officials will hear from their constituents and act on their concerns——官员应听取选民意见并行动，即有理由处理选民需求。

entries.title: Well-enforced laws in government transparency are needed to ___.
entries.text: Well-enforced laws in government transparency are needed to ___. [A] awaken the conscience of officials. 唤醒官员的良知。 [B] allow for certain kinds of lobbying. 允许某些形式的游说。 [C] guarantee fair play in official access. [D] inspire hopes in average people. 激发普通人的希望。 答案 C Well-enforced laws in government transparency are needed to ___.要___ ，需要执行良好的政府透明度法律。 [A] awaken the conscience of officials.唤醒官员的良知。 [B] allow for certain kinds of lobbying.允许某些形式的游说。 [C] guarantee fair play in official access. [D] inspire hopes in average people.激发普通人的希望。 💡 考场思路第六段：ensure equality of access to government——确保平等接触政府，即公平对待。

entries.title: The author's attitude toward the court's ruling is ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude toward the court's ruling is ___. [A] sarcastic. 讽刺的。 [B] tolerant. 宽容的。 [C] skeptical. 怀疑的。 [D] supportive. 答案 D The author's attitude toward the court's ruling is ___.作者对法院裁决的态度是___。 [A] sarcastic.讽刺的。 [B] tolerant.宽容的。 [C] skeptical.怀疑的。 [D] supportive. 💡 考场思路末段：The court's ruling is a step forward——作者认为这是进步，即支持。 核心词汇 perception n. 感知 undermine v. 破坏 governance n. 治理 inherent adj. 内在的

entries.title: But even as the number of English speakers expands further there are signs that
entries.text: But even as the number of English speakers expands further there are signs that the global predominance of the language may fade within the foreseeable future. But even as the number of English speakers expands further there are signs that the global predominance of the language may fade within the foreseeable future. 尽管讲英语的人数在进一步增加，但有迹象显示这一语言的全球统治地位在可预见的未来可能会衰落。 采分点① even as 尽管；② predominance 统治地位；③ fade 衰落；④ foreseeable future 可预见的未来。

entries.text: His analysis should therefore end any self-contentedness among those who may believe that the global position of English is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities. Second, the nearby city park is worth a visit; famous for its lake and bamboo groves, it offers a peaceful escape from the busy campus. entries.title: Who will be most threatened by automation?
entries.text: Who will be most threatened by automation? [A] Leading politicians. 主要政客。 [B] Low-wage laborers. 低薪劳动者。 [C] Robot owners. 机器人拥有者。 [D] Middle-class workers. 答案 D Who will be most threatened by automation?谁将受到自动化的最大威胁？ [A] Leading politicians.主要政客。 [B] Low-wage laborers.低薪劳动者。 [C] Robot owners.机器人拥有者。 [D] Middle-class workers. 💡 考场思路第二段：低收入工作不吸引机器人，富人拥有机器人没事，而"middle class disproportionately squeezed"——中产阶级受压最严重。 逐项分析[A] 政治领袖 → 未提及；[B] 低薪劳动者 → 与原文相反，他们的工作不吸引机器人；[C] 机器人拥有者 → 富人没事；[D] 中产阶级 → 正确。

entries.title: Which of the following best represents the author's view?
entries.text: Which of the following best represents the author's view? [A] Worries about automation are in fact groundless. 对自动化的担忧实则毫无根据。 [B] Optimists' opinions on new tech find little support. 乐观主义者对新技术的看法鲜获支持。 [C] Issues arising from automation need to be tackled. [D] Negative consequences of new tech can be avoided. 新技术的负面后果可以避免。 答案 C Which of the following best represents the author's view?以下哪项最能代表作者的观点？ [A] Worries about automation are in fact groundless.对自动化的担忧实则毫无根据。 [B] Optimists' opinions on new tech find little support.乐观主义者对新技术的看法鲜获支持。 [C] Issues arising from automation need to be tackled. [D] Negative consequences of new tech can be avoided.新技术的负面后果可以避免。 💡 考场思路作者既不否认威胁，也不盲目乐观，而是在第四到六段连续提出教育、创业、税收三方面对策——即自动化带来的问题需要解决。 逐项分析[A] 担忧毫无根据 → 作者承认威胁，错；[B] 乐观者观点无依据 → 作者引用乐观者但补充中期需帮助，错；[C] 自动化带来的问题需应对 → 正确；[D] 负面后果可避免 → 过于绝对。

entries.title: Education in the age of automation should put more emphasis on ___.
entries.text: Education in the age of automation should put more emphasis on ___. [A] creative potential. [B] job-hunting skills. 求职技巧。 [C] individual needs. 个人需求。 [D] cooperative spirit. 合作精神。 答案 A Education in the age of automation should put more emphasis on ___.自动化时代的教育应该更加重视___。 [A] creative potential. [B] job-hunting skills.求职技巧。 [C] individual needs.个人需求。 [D] cooperative spirit.合作精神。 💡 考场思路第四段：curriculums should focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication——更重创造力。

entries.title: The author suggests that tax policies be aimed at ___.
entries.text: The author suggests that tax policies be aimed at ___. [A] encouraging the development of automation. 鼓励自动化的发展。 [B] increasing the return on capital investment. 提高资本投资的回报。 [C] easing the hostility between rich and poor. 缓解贫富之间的对立。 [D] preventing the income gap from widening. 答案 D The author suggests that tax policies be aimed at ___.作者建议，税收政策应针对___。 [A] encouraging the development of automation.鼓励自动化的发展。 [B] increasing the return on capital investment.提高资本投资的回报。 [C] easing the hostility between rich and poor.缓解贫富之间的对立。 [D] preventing the income gap from widening. 💡 考场思路第六段首句：自动化威胁 widen the gap between capital income and labor income，因此要重思税收——目的就是阻止收入差距扩大。

entries.title: In this text, the author presents a problem with ___.
entries.text: In this text, the author presents a problem with ___. [A] opposing views on it. 关于它的对立观点。 [B] possible solutions to it. [C] its alarming impacts. 其惊人的影响。 [D] its major variations. 其主要变体。 答案 B In this text, the author presents a problem with ___.在本文中，作者提出了___的问题。 [A] opposing views on it.关于它的对立观点。 [B] possible solutions to it. [C] its alarming impacts.其惊人的影响。 [D] its major variations.其主要变体。 💡 考场思路提出问题（自动化威胁中产阶级）后，作者连续给出教育、创业、税收三条对策。结构是"问题+解决方案"。 核心词汇 disproportionately adv. 不成比例地 upheaval n. 剧变 indispensable adj. 不可或缺的 dynamism n. 活力 subsidies n. 补贴 upend v. 颠覆

entries.title: According to Paragraphs 1 and 2, many young Americans cast doubt on ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraphs 1 and 2, many young Americans cast doubt on ___. [A] the justification of the news-filtering practice. 新闻过滤做法的正当性。 [B] people's preference for social media platforms. 人们对社交媒体平台的偏好。 [C] the administration's ability to handle information. 政府处理信息的能力。 [D] social media as a reliable source of news. 答案 D According to Paragraphs 1 and 2, many young Americans cast doubt on ___.根据第1段和第2段，许多美国年轻人对___表示怀疑。 [A] the justification of the news-filtering practice.新闻过滤做法的正当性。 [B] people's preference for social media platforms.人们对社交媒体平台的偏好。 [C] the administration's ability to handle information.政府处理信息的能力。 [D] social media as a reliable source of news. 💡 考场思路年轻人不认同总统用推特发新闻，且44%脸书用户不信任脸书新闻——他们怀疑社交媒体作为可靠新闻来源。

entries.title: The phrase "beef up" (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___.
entries.text: The phrase "beef up" (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___. [A] boast. 自夸；拥有。 [B] define. 界定；下定义。 [C] sharpen. [D] share. 分享；共有。 答案 C The phrase "beef up" (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___.“加强”一词（第2段）的含义最接近___。 [A] boast.自夸；拥有。 [B] define.界定；下定义。 [C] sharpen. [D] share.分享；共有。 💡 考场思路beef up their media literacy skills——既然假新闻泛滥，人们要"提高/加强"媒体素养。sharpen（磨砺、提高）最贴近。

entries.title: According to the Knight Foundation survey, young people ___.
entries.text: According to the Knight Foundation survey, young people ___. [A] tend to voice their opinions in cyberspace. 倾向于在网络空间表达意见。 [B] verify news by referring to diverse sources. [C] have a strong sense of social responsibility. 具有强烈的社会责任感。 [D] like to exchange views on "distributed trust". 喜欢就“分布式信任”交流观点。 答案 B According to the Knight Foundation survey, young people ___.根据骑士基金会的调查，年轻人___。 [A] tend to voice their opinions in cyberspace.倾向于在网络空间表达意见。 [B] verify news by referring to diverse sources. [C] have a strong sense of social responsibility.具有强烈的社会责任感。 [D] like to exchange views on "distributed trust".喜欢就“分布式信任”交流观点。 💡 考场思路第三段：they cross-check sources and prefer news from different perspectives——交叉核查来源、偏好不同视角，即通过多元来源核实新闻。

entries.title: The Barna survey found that a main cause for the fake news problem is ___.
entries.text: The Barna survey found that a main cause for the fake news problem is ___. [A] readers' misinterpretation. [B] journalists' biased reporting. 记者有偏见的报道。 [C] readers' outdated values. 读者过时的价值观。 [D] journalists' made-up stories. 记者编造的故事。 答案 A The Barna survey found that a main cause for the fake news problem is ___.Barna调查发现，假新闻问题的主要原因是___。 [A] readers' misinterpretation. [B] journalists' biased reporting.记者有偏见的报道。 [C] readers' outdated values.读者过时的价值观。 [D] journalists' made-up stories.记者编造的故事。 💡 考场思路第五段：首要原因是"reader error"，约三分之一认为问题在于"misinterpretation or exaggeration of actual news"——即读者误读。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text? [A] A Counteraction Against the Over-tweeting Trend 对过度发推特趋势的一种抵制 [B] A Rise in Critical Skills for Sharing News Online [C] The Accumulation of Mutual Trust on Social Media 社交媒体上互信的积累 [D] The Platforms for Projection of Personal Interests 投射个人兴趣的平台 答案 B Which of the following would be the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] A Counteraction Against the Over-tweeting Trend对过度发推特趋势的一种抵制 [B] A Rise in Critical Skills for Sharing News Online [C] The Accumulation of Mutual Trust on Social Media社交媒体上互信的积累 [D] The Platforms for Projection of Personal Interests投射个人兴趣的平台 💡 考场思路全文主线：年轻人媒体素养提高、学会辨别假新闻、承担分享新闻的个人责任。末句"mental discipline in thinking skills"点题。 核心词汇 literacy n. 素养 distributed trust 分布式信任 cross-check v. 交叉核查 engagement n. 参与度 projection n. 投射 counteract v. 对抗/抵消

entries.title: What is true of the agreement between the NHS and DeepMind?
entries.text: What is true of the agreement between the NHS and DeepMind? [A] It fell short of the latter's expectations. 它未能达到后者的期望。 [B] It caused conflicts among tech giants. 它引发了科技巨头之间的冲突。 [C] It failed to pay due attention to patients' rights. [D] It put both sides into a dangerous situation. 它使双方陷入危险境地。 答案 C What is true of the agreement between the NHS and DeepMind?NHS和DeepMind之间的协议是什么？ [A] It fell short of the latter's expectations.它未能达到后者的期望。 [B] It caused conflicts among tech giants.它引发了科技巨头之间的冲突。 [C] It failed to pay due attention to patients' rights. [D] It put both sides into a dangerous situation.它使双方陷入危险境地。 💡 考场思路首段末：协议"took far too little account of the patients' rights and their expectations of privacy"——几乎没顾及患者权利。

entries.title: The NHS trust responded to Denham's verdict with ___.
entries.text: The NHS trust responded to Denham's verdict with ___. [A] empty promises. 空洞的承诺。 [B] tough resistance. 顽固的抵制。 [C] sincere apologies. 诚挚的歉意。 [D] necessary adjustments. 答案 D The NHS trust responded to Denham's verdict with ___.NHS信托以___回应了Denham的判决。 [A] empty promises.空洞的承诺。 [B] tough resistance.顽固的抵制。 [C] sincere apologies.诚挚的歉意。 [D] necessary adjustments. 💡 考场思路第二段：The NHS trust has mended its ways（已改正做法）——即做出必要调整。

entries.title: The author argues in Paragraph 2 that ___.
entries.text: The author argues in Paragraph 2 that ___. [A] privacy protection must be secured at all costs. 隐私保护必须不惜一切代价得到保障。 [B] the value of data comes from the processing of it. [C] making profits from patients' data is illegal. 利用患者数据牟利是非法的。 [D] leaking patients' data is worse than selling it. 泄露患者数据比出售它更恶劣。 答案 B The author argues in Paragraph 2 that ___.作者在第2段中指出___。 [A] privacy protection must be secured at all costs.隐私保护必须不惜一切代价得到保障。 [B] the value of data comes from the processing of it. [C] making profits from patients' data is illegal.利用患者数据牟利是非法的。 [D] leaking patients' data is worse than selling it.泄露患者数据比出售它更恶劣。 💡 考场思路第二段末句强调：赋予数据价值的是 processing and aggregation（处理与聚合），而非单纯占有。

entries.title: According to the last paragraph, the real worry arising from this deal is ___.
entries.text: According to the last paragraph, the real worry arising from this deal is ___. [A] the monopoly of big data by tech giants. [B] the vicious rivalry among big pharmas. 大型药企间的恶性竞争。 [C] the uncontrolled use of new software. 对新软件的滥用。 [D] the ineffective enforcement of privacy law. 隐私法执行不力。 答案 A According to the last paragraph, the real worry arising from this deal is ___.根据最后一段，这笔交易引起的真正担忧是___。 [A] the monopoly of big data by tech giants. [B] the vicious rivalry among big pharmas.大型药企间的恶性竞争。 [C] the uncontrolled use of new software.对新软件的滥用。 [D] the ineffective enforcement of privacy law.隐私法执行不力。 💡 考场思路末段：关键在于算法将属于"a private monopoly"（私人垄断），用公共资源开发——真正担忧是科技巨头对大数据的垄断。

entries.title: The author's attitude toward the application of AI to healthcare is ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude toward the application of AI to healthcare is ___. [A] ambiguous. 模糊的；模棱两可的。 [B] appreciative. 欣赏的；感激的。 [C] cautious. [D] contemptuous. 轻蔑的。 答案 C The author's attitude toward the application of AI to healthcare is ___.作者对人工智能在医疗保健中的应用的态度是___。 [A] ambiguous.模糊的；模棱两可的。 [B] appreciative.欣赏的；感激的。 [C] cautious. [D] contemptuous.轻蔑的。 💡 考场思路作者既承认AI医疗潜力大，又反复警示垄断、数字封建主义风险——态度是谨慎的。 核心词汇 fair-minded adj. 公正的 damning adj. 定罪的/谴责的 scrutinise v. 仔细审查 aggregation n. 聚合 maladapted adj. 不适应的 feudalism n. 封建主义

entries.title: The financial problem with the USPS is caused partly by ___.
entries.text: The financial problem with the USPS is caused partly by ___. [A] its unbalanced budget. 其不平衡的预算。 [B] its rigid management. [C] the cost for technical upgrading. 技术升级的成本。 [D] the withdrawal of bank support. 银行支持的退出。 答案 B The financial problem with the USPS is caused partly by ___.USPS的财务问题部分是由___引起的。 [A] its unbalanced budget.其不平衡的预算。 [B] its rigid management. [C] the cost for technical upgrading.技术升级的成本。 [D] the withdrawal of bank support.银行支持的退出。 💡 考场思路首段末：监管结构"denies management the flexibility to adjust"——剥夺了管理灵活性，即管理僵化。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 2, the USPS fails to modernize itself due to ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 2, the USPS fails to modernize itself due to ___. [A] the interference from interest groups. [B] the inadequate funding from Congress. 国会拨款的不足。 [C] the shrinking demand for postal service. 邮政服务需求的萎缩。 [D] the incompetence of postal unions. 邮政工会的无能。 答案 A According to Paragraph 2, the USPS fails to modernize itself due to ___.根据第2款，由于___ ， USPS未能实现现代化。 [A] the interference from interest groups. [B] the inadequate funding from Congress.国会拨款的不足。 [C] the shrinking demand for postal service.邮政服务需求的萎缩。 [D] the incompetence of postal unions.邮政工会的无能。 💡 考场思路第二段：利益集团向国会施压保护现状，导致改革立法失败，只能推迟现代化。即利益集团干预。

entries.title: The long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions can be addressed by ___.
entries.text: The long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions can be addressed by ___. [A] removing its burden of retiree health care. [B] making more investment in new vehicles. 对新型车辆进行更多投资。 [C] adopting a new rate-increase mechanism. 采用新的涨价机制。 [D] attracting more first-class mail users. 吸引更多一类邮件用户。 答案 A The long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions can be addressed by ___.美国邮政及其工会的长期投诉可以通过___解决。 [A] removing its burden of retiree health care. [B] making more investment in new vehicles.对新型车辆进行更多投资。 [C] adopting a new rate-increase mechanism.采用新的涨价机制。 [D] attracting more first-class mail users.吸引更多一类邮件用户。 💡 考场思路第三段末：把退休人员转入Medicare，"offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care"——即卸下退休人员医疗负担。

entries.title: In the last paragraph, the author seems to view legislators with ___.
entries.text: In the last paragraph, the author seems to view legislators with ___. [A] respect. 尊重；尊敬。 [B] tolerance. 宽容；容忍。 [C] discontent. [D] gratitude. 感激。 答案 C In the last paragraph, the author seems to view legislators with ___.在最后一段中，作者似乎将立法者视为___。 [A] respect.尊重；尊敬。 [B] tolerance.宽容；容忍。 [C] discontent. [D] gratitude.感激。 💡 考场思路末段作者批评法案只是bare minimum、重大遗漏、扼杀合理改革——对议员明显不满。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text? [A] The USPS Starts to Miss Its Good Old Days 美国邮政开始怀念往昔好时光 [B] The Postal Service: Keep Away from My Cheese 邮政服务：别动我的奶酪 [C] The USPS: Chronic Illness Requires a Quick Cure 美国邮政：慢性病需速治 [D] The Postal Service Needs More than a Band-Aid 答案 D Which of the following would be the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] The USPS Starts to Miss Its Good Old Days美国邮政开始怀念往昔好时光 [B] The Postal Service: Keep Away from My Cheese邮政服务：别动我的奶酪 [C] The USPS: Chronic Illness Requires a Quick Cure美国邮政：慢性病需速治 [D] The Postal Service Needs More than a Band-Aid 💡 考场思路作者认为现有改革只是权宜之计（band-aid），远非全面改革，需要更深层的转型。 核心词汇 bleed red ink 亏损 liability n. 负债 on the verge of 濒于 defer v. 推迟 offset v. 抵消 omission n. 遗漏

entries.title: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious dram
entries.text: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy. By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy. 到他出生时，欧洲正见证宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧和喜剧的激励之下新戏剧形式的诞生。 采分点① by the date of his birth 到他出生时；② witness 见证；③ the passing of ……的衰落/消逝；④ under the incentive of 在……激励下。

entries.title: no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form
entries.text: no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England. no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England. 任何上过文法学校的男孩都不会不知道，戏剧是一种文学形式，它曾给希腊和罗马带来荣耀，或许也终将给英国带来荣光。 采分点① cannot be ignorant that 不会不知道（双重否定）；② give glory to 给……带来荣耀；③ might yet 或许终将。

entries.title: But the professional companies prospered in their permanent theaters, and univer
entries.text: But the professional companies prospered in their permanent theaters, and university men with literary ambitions were quick to turn to these theaters as offering a means of livelihood. But the professional companies prospered in their permanent theaters, and university men with literary ambitions were quick to turn to these theaters as offering a means of livelihood. 但是，职业剧团在固定剧院里蓬勃发展，那些有文学抱负的大学毕业生也很快转向这些剧院，将其作为一种谋生手段。 采分点① prosper 蓬勃发展；② permanent theaters 固定剧院；③ a means of livelihood 谋生手段。

entries.title: A native literary drama had been created, its alliance with the public playhouse

A native literary drama had been created, its alliance with the public playhouses established, and at least some of its great traditions had been begun. 一种本土的文学戏剧已然形成，它与公共剧院的联盟也已确立，至少其某些伟大传统也已开始。 采分点① native 本土的；② its alliance…established 独立主格结构；③ 并列完成时的翻译要保持时态一致。

entries.text: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived. To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived. 要了解当时的戏剧活动是何等繁荣，我们还必须记住，大量剧作已经散佚，而且很可能没有一位知名作家的全部作品都流传了下来。 采分点① To realize 要认识到（不定式作目的）；② hosts of 大量；③ author of note 知名作家；④ survive 流传下来。

entries.title: Write an email to all the international experts on campus, inviting them to atte
entries.text: Write an email to all the international experts on campus, inviting them to attend the graduation ceremony. The email should include the time and place of the ceremony as well as other relevant information. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 邀请邮件 原题指令 Directions Write an email to all the international experts on campus, inviting them to attend the graduation ceremony. The email should include the time and place of the ceremony as well as other relevant information. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. 【译文】给校内所有国际专家写一封电子邮件，邀请他们参加毕业典礼。邮件应包含典礼的时间、地点及其他相关信息。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。 题目 给校内所有国际专家写一封邮件，邀请他们参加毕业典礼。邮件中应包含典礼的时间、地点及其他相关信息。约100词，落款用"Li Ming"，不要写自己真名。 审题 ① 文体：正式邀请邮件；② 必含三要素：时间、地点、其他相关信息（着装/流程/回执）；③ 语气：尊敬、热情。 参考范文 Dear International Experts, On behalf of the Students' Union, I am writing to cordially invite you to attend our university's graduation ceremony, which will be held in the Main Hall at 9:00 a.m. on Friday, June 21. The ceremony will include the president's address, the conferring of degrees and a group photograph. As our distinguished guests, you are kindly requested to arrive 30 minutes early and be seated on the platform. Please confirm your attendance by June 14 via the link attached. We would be deeply honored by your presence. Looking forward to your reply. Yours sincerely, Li Ming

In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows a student hesitating before the course-selection system. One speech bubble says the courses are "new in knowledge, innovation-oriented and challenging", while another says they are "high-scoring, easy to pass and with little homework". 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 漫画展示一名学生面对选课系统犹豫不决。一个气泡说 图画解读 学生面对选课系统，一个气泡是"知识新、重创新、有难度"，另一个气泡是"给分高、易通过、作业少"。漫画揭示大学生选课的功利倾向：避难就易，还是追求真才实学？ 审题框架 三段式：①简要描述图画；②点明寓意——选课观折射学习态度；③评论：大学生应重真学问而非分数捷径。160-200词。 参考范文 As is vividly shown in the cartoon, a student hesitates before the course-selection system, caught between two tempting options: courses that are new, innovation-oriented and challenging, and courses that promise high grades, easy credits and little homework. The drawing conveys a thought-provoking message: course selection mirrors a student's underlying attitude toward learning. [A] from 从；来自 [B] under 在……之下；根据 [C] beyond 超出；在……之外 [D] through 答案 D through Another 12: Climb high and look for signs of human habitation. 13, even in dense forest, you should be able to 14 gaps in the tree line due to roads, train tracks, and other paths people carve 15 the woods. Head toward these 16 to find a way out. At night, scan the horizon for 17 light sources, such as fires and streetlights, then walk toward the glow of light pollution. [A] from从；来自 [B] under在……之下；根据 [C] beyond超出；在……之外 [D] through 💡 考场思路paths people carve through the woods = 人们在林中开辟出的路。through 表穿过树林。

entries.title: Head toward these 16 to find a way out.
entries.text: Head toward these 16 to find a way out. [A] posts 柱子 [B] breaks 缺口 [C] shades 阴凉 [D] links 连接 答案 B breaks Another 12: Climb high and look for signs of human habitation. 13, even in dense forest, you should be able to 14 gaps in the tree line due to roads, train tracks, and other paths people carve 15 the woods. Head toward these 16 to find a way out. At night, scan the horizon for 17 light sources, such as fires and streetlights, then walk toward the glow of light pollution. [A] posts 柱子 [B] breaks 缺口 [C] shades 阴凉 [D] links 连接 💡 考场思路these ___ 指代前面 gaps in the tree line。gaps = breaks。

entries.title: At night, scan the horizon for 17 light sources, such as fires and streetlights,
entries.text: At night, scan the horizon for 17 light sources, such as fires and streetlights, then walk toward the glow of light pollution. [A] hidden 隐藏的 [B] mysterious 神秘的 [C] artificial 人工的 [D] limited 有限的 答案 C artificial Another 12: Climb high and look for signs of human habitation. 13, even in dense forest, you should be able to 14 gaps in the tree line due to roads, train tracks, and other paths people carve 15 the woods. Head toward these 16 to find a way out. At night, scan the horizon for 17 light sources, such as fires and streetlights, then walk toward the glow of light pollution. [A] hidden 隐藏的 [B] mysterious 神秘的 [C] artificial 人工的 [D] limited 有限的 💡 考场思路fires and streetlights 都是"人工"光源。artificial light sources 固定搭配。

entries.title: 18, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the 19 we
entries.text: 18, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the 19 we leave on the landscape. [A] Finally 最后 [B] Consequently 结果 [C] Incidentally 顺便说 [D] Generally 一般 答案 A Finally 18, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the 19 we leave on the landscape. Trail blazes, tire tracks, and other features can 20 you to civilization. [A] Finally 最后 [B] Consequently 结果 [C] Incidentally 顺便说 [D] Generally 一般 💡 考场思路列举的最后一个诀窍，用 Finally。

entries.title: 18, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the 19 we
entries.text: 18, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the 19 we leave on the landscape. [A] memories 记忆 [B] belongings 随身物 [C] notes 笔记 [D] marks 记号 答案 D marks 18, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the 19 we leave on the landscape. Trail blazes, tire tracks, and other features can 20 you to civilization. [A] memories 记忆 [B] belongings 随身物 [C] notes 笔记 [D] marks 记号 💡 考场思路后面举例 Trail blazes（路标刻痕）、轮胎印——都是人类留在大地的"记号"。

entries.title: Trail blazes, tire tracks, and other features can 20 you to civilization.
entries.text: Trail blazes, tire tracks, and other features can 20 you to civilization. [A] lead 引导 [B] adapt 适应 [C] restrict 限制 [D] expose 暴露 答案 A lead 18, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the 19 we leave on the landscape. Trail blazes, tire tracks, and other features can 20 you to civilization. [A] lead 引导 [B] adapt 适应 [C] restrict 限制 [D] expose 暴露 💡 考场思路路标和轮胎印能"引导"你回到文明世界。lead sb to = 把某人引到。 ⚠️ 完形总结本文是科普说明文，按"循地形→认景物→登高远望→夜间看光→找人工记号"并列列举。抓段落首句的诀窍提示词（Another / For example / Finally）。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 1, one motive in imposing the new rule is to ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 1, one motive in imposing the new rule is to ___. [A] guarantee the bonuses of top executives. 保障高管的奖金。 [B] enhance bankers' sense of responsibility. [C] build a new system of financial regulation. 建立新的金融监管体系。 [D] help corporations achieve larger profits. 帮助企业获得更大利润。 答案 B According to Paragraph 1, one motive in imposing the new rule is to ___.根据第1款，实施新规则的一个动机是___。 [A] guarantee the bonuses of top executives.保障高管的奖金。 [B] enhance bankers' sense of responsibility. [C] build a new system of financial regulation.建立新的金融监管体系。 [D] help corporations achieve larger profits.帮助企业获得更大利润。 💡 考场思路首段：目的之一是"hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking"——让银行家负责，即增强责任感。 逐项分析[A] 保证高管奖金 → 与推迟奖金相反；[B] 增强银行家责任感 → 正确，hold accountable；[C] 建新监管体系 → 过度；[D] 帮公司赚更多 → 与长期主义相悖。

entries.title: Alfred Marshall is quoted to indicate ___.
entries.text: Alfred Marshall is quoted to indicate ___. [A] the solid structure of publicly traded companies. 上市公司的稳固结构。 [B] governments' impatience in decision-making. 政府在决策上的急躁。 [C] the conditions for generating quick profits. 快速获利的条件。 [D] "short-termism" in economic activities. 答案 D Alfred Marshall is quoted to indicate ___.引用阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔（ Alfred Marshall ）来表示___。 [A] the solid structure of publicly traded companies.上市公司的稳固结构。 [B] governments' impatience in decision-making.政府在决策上的急躁。 [C] the conditions for generating quick profits.快速获利的条件。 [D] "short-termism" in economic activities. 💡 考场思路引用马歇尔是为了说明段首论点："Short-termism" or the desire for quick profits has worsened。例子前的论点即答案。

entries.title: It is argued that the influence of transient investment on public companies can
entries.text: It is argued that the influence of transient investment on public companies can be ___. [A] minimal. 最小的；极少的。 [B] indirect. 间接的。 [C] adverse. [D] temporary. 暂时的。 答案 C It is argued that the influence of transient investment on public companies can be ___.有人认为，短暂投资对上市公司的影响可以___。 [A] minimal.最小的；极少的。 [B] indirect.间接的。 [C] adverse. [D] temporary.暂时的。 💡 考场思路第三段：Transient investors can hinder a firm's efforts to invest in long-term research——hinder 是负面，即不利的 adverse。

entries.title: The US and France examples are used to illustrate ___.
entries.text: The US and France examples are used to illustrate ___. [A] the approaches to promoting "long-termism." [B] the prevalence of short-term thinking. 短期思维的盛行。 [C] the significance of long-term thinking. 长远思维的意义。 [D] the obstacles to preventing "short-termism." 防范“短期主义”的障碍。 答案 A The US and France examples are used to illustrate ___.用美国和法国的例子来说明___。 [A] the approaches to promoting "long-termism." [B] the prevalence of short-term thinking.短期思维的盛行。 [C] the significance of long-term thinking.长远思维的意义。 [D] the obstacles to preventing "short-termism."防范“短期主义”的障碍。 💡 考场思路美法两例都在第六段，该段首句即论点：Much more could be done to encourage "long-termism"——即鼓励长期主义的各种做法。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text? [A] Decisiveness Required of Top Executives 顶尖高管所需的决断力 [B] Failure of Quarterly Capitalism 季度资本主义的失败 [C] Patience as a Corporate Virtue [D] Frustration of Risk-taking Bankers 冒险银行家的挫败 答案 C Which of the following would be the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Decisiveness Required of Top Executives顶尖高管所需的决断力 [B] Failure of Quarterly Capitalism季度资本主义的失败 [C] Patience as a Corporate Virtue [D] Frustration of Risk-taking Bankers冒险银行家的挫败 💡 考场思路全文批判短期主义、倡导长期主义，即呼吁企业"有耐心"。Patience = 长期主义的核心美德。 核心词汇 clawback n. 追回 accountable adj. 负责任的 short-termism n. 短期主义 transient adj. 短暂的 predominance n. 主导 stakeholder n. 利益相关者

entries.title: What is commonly regarded as the cause of grade inflation?
entries.text: What is commonly regarded as the cause of grade inflation? [A] Colleges' neglect of GPAs. 大学对平均绩点（GPA）的忽视。 [B] The influence of consumer culture. [C] Students' indifference to GPAs. 学生对GPA的漠不关心。 [D] The change of course catalogs. 课程目录的变化。 答案 B What is commonly regarded as the cause of grade inflation?通常认为等级膨胀的原因是什么？ [A] Colleges' neglect of GPAs.大学对平均绩点（GPA）的忽视。 [B] The influence of consumer culture. [C] Students' indifference to GPAs.学生对GPA的漠不关心。 [D] The change of course catalogs.课程目录的变化。 💡 考场思路首段：成绩膨胀"is often considered a product of a consumer era"——常被视为消费时代/消费文化的产物。

entries.title: What was the original purpose of grade forgiveness?
entries.text: What was the original purpose of grade forgiveness? [A] To maintain colleges' graduation rates. 维持高校的毕业率。 [B] To increase universities' income from tuition. 增加大学的学费收入。 [C] To prepare graduates for a challenging future. 让毕业生为充满挑战的未来做好准备。 [D] To help freshmen adapt to college learning. 答案 D What was the original purpose of grade forgiveness?成绩豁免制度最初的目的是什么？ [A] To maintain colleges' graduation rates.维持高校的毕业率。 [B] To increase universities' income from tuition.增加大学的学费收入。 [C] To prepare graduates for a challenging future.让毕业生为充满挑战的未来做好准备。 [D] To help freshmen adapt to college learning. 💡 考场思路第三段：最初只限大一新生，"give them a second chance… if they struggled in their transition to college-level courses"——帮新生适应大学学习。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 5, grade forgiveness enables colleges to ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 5, grade forgiveness enables colleges to ___. [A] obtain more financial support. [B] improve their teaching quality. 提升其教学质量。 [C] boost their student enrollments. 提升其学生入学率。 [D] meet local governments' needs. 满足地方政府的需求。 答案 A According to Paragraph 5, grade forgiveness enables colleges to ___.根据第5段，年级宽恕使大学能够___。 [A] obtain more financial support. [B] improve their teaching quality.提升其教学质量。 [C] boost their student enrollments.提升其学生入学率。 [D] meet local governments' needs.满足地方政府的需求。 💡 考场思路第五段：州拨款与毕业率等指标挂钩，成绩好=数字高=更多钱。即获得更多财政支持。

entries.title: What does the phrase "to be aligned" (Para. 6) most probably mean?
entries.text: What does the phrase "to be aligned" (Para. 6) most probably mean? [A] To counterbalance each other. 相互制衡。 [B] To be contradictory to each other. 彼此相互矛盾。 [C] To be identical with each other. [D] To complement each other. 彼此互补。 答案 C What does the phrase "to be aligned" (Para. 6) most probably mean?“要保持一致” （第6段）最有可能是什么意思？ [A] To counterbalance each other.相互制衡。 [B] To be contradictory to each other.彼此相互矛盾。 [C] To be identical with each other. [D] To complement each other.彼此互补。 💡 考场思路学生要文凭找工作，学校要培养"看起来合格"的毕业生——双方动机一致。aligned = 一致、相同。

entries.title: The author examines the practice of grade forgiveness by ___.
entries.text: The author examines the practice of grade forgiveness by ___. [A] assessing its feasibility. 评估其可行性。 [B] listing its long-run effects. 列举其长期影响。 [C] comparing different views on it. 比较关于它的不同观点。 [D] analyzing the causes behind it. 答案 D The author examines the practice of grade forgiveness by ___.作者在___之前检查了等级宽恕的实践。 [A] assessing its feasibility.评估其可行性。 [B] listing its long-run effects.列举其长期影响。 [C] comparing different views on it.比较关于它的不同观点。 [D] analyzing the causes behind it. 💡 考场思路作者从消费文化、学校牟利、学生消费者期望等多个角度分析成绩宽容背后的成因。 核心词汇 grade inflation 成绩膨胀 consumer era 消费时代 retake v. 重修 registrar n. 教务主任 retention n. 留校率 aligned adj. 一致的

entries.title: Mary Shelley's novel Frankenstein is mentioned because it ___.
entries.text: Mary Shelley's novel Frankenstein is mentioned because it ___. [A] involves some concerns raised by AI today. [B] has remained popular for as long as 200 years. 已流行长达200年之久。 [C] fascinates AI scientists all over the world. 令全球人工智能科学家着迷。 [D] has sparked serious ethical controversies. 引发了严重的伦理争议。 答案 A Mary Shelley's novel Frankenstein is mentioned because it ___.玛丽·雪莱的小说《弗兰肯斯坦》之所以被提及，是因为它___。 [A] involves some concerns raised by AI today. [B] has remained popular for as long as 200 years.已流行长达200年之久。 [C] fascinates AI scientists all over the world.令全球人工智能科学家着迷。 [D] has sparked serious ethical controversies.引发了严重的伦理争议。 💡 考场思路首段：《弗兰肯斯坦》foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come——预示了技术（即今天AI）将引发的伦理问题。

entries.title: In David Eagleman's opinion, our current knowledge of consciousness ___.
entries.text: In David Eagleman's opinion, our current knowledge of consciousness ___. [A] helps explain artificial intelligence. 有助于解释人工智能。 [B] is too limited for us to reproduce it. [C] inspires popular sci-fi TV series. 启发了热门科幻电视剧。 [D] can be misleading to robot making. 可能误导机器人制造。 答案 B In David Eagleman's opinion, our current knowledge of consciousness ___.在David Eagleman看来，我们目前的意识知识___。 [A] helps explain artificial intelligence.有助于解释人工智能。 [B] is too limited for us to reproduce it. [C] inspires popular sci-fi TV series.启发了热门科幻电视剧。 [D] can be misleading to robot making.可能误导机器人制造。 💡 考场思路第四段：how people think is far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced——意识太复杂，我们理解都难，更别说复制。

entries.title: The solution to the ethical issues brought by autonomous vehicles ___.
entries.text: The solution to the ethical issues brought by autonomous vehicles ___. [A] can hardly ever be found. 几乎不可能被找到。 [B] has aroused much curiosity. 引发了诸多好奇。 [C] is still beyond our capacity. [D] causes little public concern. 几乎不引起公众关注。 答案 C The solution to the ethical issues brought by autonomous vehicles ___.自动驾驶汽车带来的伦理问题的解决方案___。 [A] can hardly ever be found.几乎不可能被找到。 [B] has aroused much curiosity.引发了诸多好奇。 [C] is still beyond our capacity. [D] causes little public concern.几乎不引起公众关注。 💡 考场思路第五段：AI视觉远不如人，预见每种驾驶情形是艰难的编程问题——即解决之道仍超出我们能力。

entries.title: The author's attitude toward Google's pledge is one of ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude toward Google's pledge is one of ___. [A] contempt. 蔑视；轻蔑。 [B] skepticism. 怀疑；质疑。 [C] respect. 尊重。 [D] affirmation. 答案 D The author's attitude toward Google's pledge is one of ___.作者对Google订阅的态度是___。 [A] contempt.蔑视；轻蔑。 [B] skepticism.怀疑；质疑。 [C] respect.尊重。 [D] affirmation. 💡 考场思路作者说声明虽含糊但"represents one starting point"——认可它是个好的开端，持肯定态度。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text? [A] The Conscience of AI: Complex But Inevitable [B] Frankenstein, the Novel Predicting the Age of AI 《弗兰肯斯坦》：预言AI时代的小说 [C] AI's Future: In the Hands of Tech Giants AI的未来：掌握在科技巨头手中 [D] AI Shall Be Killers Once Out of Control 一旦失控，AI 将成为杀手 答案 A Which of the following would be the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] The Conscience of AI: Complex But Inevitable [B] Frankenstein, the Novel Predicting the Age of AI《弗兰肯斯坦》：预言AI时代的小说 [C] AI's Future: In the Hands of Tech GiantsAI的未来：掌握在科技巨头手中 [D] AI Shall Be Killers Once Out of Control一旦失控，AI 将成为杀手 💡 考场思路全文围绕AI伦理问题的复杂性，以及各国各公司开始制定准则——AI良知虽复杂但不可避免要面对。 核心词汇 speculative fiction 推测小说/科幻 foreshadow v. 预示 consciousness n. 意识 thorny adj. 棘手的 pledge v./n. 承诺 deploy v. 部署

entries.title: The Supreme Court decision Thursday will ___.
entries.text: The Supreme Court decision Thursday will ___. [A] put most online business in a dilemma. 使多数在线业务陷入两难。 [B] force some states to cut sales tax. 迫使一些州削减销售税。 [C] make more online shoppers pay sales tax. [D] better businesses' relations with states. 改善企业与各州的关系。 答案 C The Supreme Court decision Thursday will ___.最高法院周四的决定将___。 [A] put most online business in a dilemma.使多数在线业务陷入两难。 [B] force some states to cut sales tax.迫使一些州削减销售税。 [C] make more online shoppers pay sales tax. [D] better businesses' relations with states.改善企业与各州的关系。 💡 考场思路首段：force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases——让更多网购者缴税。

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraphs 2 and 3 that the overruled decisions ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraphs 2 and 3 that the overruled decisions ___. [A] were widely criticized by online purchases. 受到网购的广泛批评（原文逻辑存疑）。 [B] have cost consumers a lot over the years. 多年来让消费者付出了巨大代价。 [C] have led to the dominance of e-commerce. 导致了电子商务的主导地位。 [D] were considered unfavorable by states. 答案 D It can be learned from Paragraphs 2 and 3 that the overruled decisions ___.从第2段和第3段中可以了解到，被推翻的决定___。 [A] were widely criticized by online purchases.受到网购的广泛批评（原文逻辑存疑）。 [B] have cost consumers a lot over the years.多年来让消费者付出了巨大代价。 [C] have led to the dominance of e-commerce.导致了电子商务的主导地位。 [D] were considered unfavorable by states. 💡 考场思路第二段：旧裁决让各州每年损失数十亿美元税收——对各州不利。

entries.title: According to Justice Anthony Kennedy, the physical presence rule has ___.
entries.text: According to Justice Anthony Kennedy, the physical presence rule has ___. [A] hindered economic development. 阻碍了经济发展。 [B] harmed fair market competition. [C] boosted growth in states' revenue. 推动了各州财政收入的增长。 [D] brought prosperity to the country. 为国家带来繁荣。 答案 B According to Justice Anthony Kennedy, the physical presence rule has ___.根据安东尼·肯尼迪大法官的说法，实体存在规则有___。 [A] hindered economic development.阻碍了经济发展。 [B] harmed fair market competition. [C] boosted growth in states' revenue.推动了各州财政收入的增长。 [D] brought prosperity to the country.为国家带来繁荣。 💡 考场思路第四段末：该规则"prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field"——破坏了公平竞争。

entries.title: Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling?
entries.text: Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling? [A] Big-chain owners. [B] Third-party sellers. 第三方卖家。 [C] Internet entrepreneurs. 互联网企业家。 [D] Small retailers. 小型零售商。 答案 A Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling?谁最有可能欢迎最高法院的裁决？ [A] Big-chain owners. [B] Third-party sellers.第三方卖家。 [C] Internet entrepreneurs.互联网企业家。 [D] Small retailers.小型零售商。 💡 考场思路第五段首句：The ruling is a victory for big chains——大连锁是赢家。

entries.title: In dealing with the Supreme Court decision Thursday, the author ___.
entries.text: In dealing with the Supreme Court decision Thursday, the author ___. [A] presents its main points with conflicting views on them. 呈现其主要观点并附上相互冲突的看法。 [B] gives a factual account of it and discusses its consequences. [C] cites some cases related to it and analyzes their implications. 引用了与之相关的若干案例并分析了其启示。 [D] describes the long and complicated process of its making. 描述了其制作漫长而复杂的过程。 答案 B In dealing with the Supreme Court decision Thursday, the author ___.在处理最高法院周四的裁决时，提交人___。 [A] presents its main points with conflicting views on them.呈现其主要观点并附上相互冲突的看法。 [B] gives a factual account of it and discusses its consequences. [C] cites some cases related to it and analyzes their implications.引用了与之相关的若干案例并分析了其启示。 [D] describes the long and complicated process of its making.描述了其制作漫长而复杂的过程。 💡 考场思路作者客观陈述裁决内容，然后分析谁受益、谁受损（大连锁赢、小卖家输）——即事实陈述+后果讨论。 核心词汇 overrule v. 推翻 physical presence 实体存在 even playing field 公平竞争环境 revenue n. 税收/收入 level the playing field 公平竞争 comply with 遵守

entries.title: Scientists say the compound is 11 to cause cancer but have no hard scientific pr
entries.text: Scientists say the compound is 11 to cause cancer but have no hard scientific proof. [A] likely 可能的 [B] bound 必定的 [C] insufficient 不足的 [D] slow 缓慢的 💡 考场思路be likely to cause cancer = 可能致癌。bound to 语气太强。

entries.text: 12 the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is 13 to follow the FSA advice. [A] In addition to 除……之外 [B] At the cost of 以……为代价 [C] On the basis of 基于 [D] In contrast to 与……对比 💡 考场思路基于预防原则，听从建议是明智的。on the basis of = 基于。

entries.title: 12 the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is 13 to follow the F
entries.text: 12 the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is 13 to follow the FSA advice. [A] interesting 有趣的 [B] fortunate 幸运的 [C] urgent 紧急的 [D] advisable 明智的 答案 D advisable Scientists say the compound is 11 to cause cancer but have no hard scientific proof. 12 the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is 13 to follow the FSA advice. 14, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was found to prove a 15. [A] interesting 有趣的 [B] fortunate 幸运的 [C] urgent 紧急的 [D] advisable 明智的 💡 考场思路基于预防原则，听从建议是"明智的"。

entries.title: 14, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was
entries.text: 14, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was found to prove a 15. [A] As usual 像往常 [B] After all 毕竟 [C] By definition 按定义 [D] In particular 尤其 答案 B After all Scientists say the compound is 11 to cause cancer but have no hard scientific proof. 12 the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is 13 to follow the FSA advice. 14, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was found to prove a 15. [A] As usual 像往常 [B] After all 毕竟 [C] By definition 按定义 [D] In particular 尤其 💡 考场思路"毕竟，吸烟致癌的传闻流传多年才被证实"——举例说明预防原则的合理性，选 After all。

entries.title: 14, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was
entries.text: 14, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was found to prove a 15. [A] connection 关联 [B] combination 结合 [C] resemblance 相似 [D] pattern 模式 答案 A connection Scientists say the compound is 11 to cause cancer but have no hard scientific proof. 12 the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is 13 to follow the FSA advice. 14, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was found to prove a 15. [A] connection 关联 [B] combination 结合 [C] resemblance 相似 [D] pattern 模式 💡 考场思路prove a connection = 证明（吸烟与癌症的）关联。

entries.title: Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be 16 up on Sunday alongside some st
entries.text: Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be 16 up on Sunday alongside some steamed vegetables, without the Yorkshire pudding and no wine. [A] made 制作 [B] used 使用 [C] saved 节省 [D] served 端上 答案 D served Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be 16 up on Sunday alongside some steamed vegetables, without the Yorkshire pudding and no wine. But would life be worth living? 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to reduce their lifetime intake. However, its 19 risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective. Constant health scares just 20 with no one listening. [A] made 制作 [B] used 使用 [C] saved 节省 [D] served 端上 💡 考场思路be served up on Sunday = 周日端上桌（饭菜）。serve up 上菜。

entries.title: 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to redu
entries.text: 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to reduce their lifetime intake. [A] To be brief 简言之 [B] For instance 例如 [C] To be fair 平心而论 [D] In general 一般 答案 C To be fair Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be 16 up on Sunday alongside some steamed vegetables, without the Yorkshire pudding and no wine. But would life be worth living? 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to reduce their lifetime intake. However, its 19 risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective. Constant health scares just 20 with no one listening. [A] To be brief 简言之 [B] For instance 例如 [C] To be fair 平心而论 [D] In general 一般 💡 考场思路为FSA说句公道话：它不是让你完全戒掉，只是减量。To be fair 表公平起见。

entries.title: 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to redu
entries.text: 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to reduce their lifetime intake. [A] entirely 完全地 [B] reluctantly 不情愿地 [C] gradually 逐渐地 [D] carefully 小心地 答案 A entirely Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be 16 up on Sunday alongside some steamed vegetables, without the Yorkshire pudding and no wine. But would life be worth living? 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to reduce their lifetime intake. However, its 19 risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective. Constant health scares just 20 with no one listening. [A] entirely 完全地 [B] reluctantly 不情愿地 [C] gradually 逐渐地 [D] carefully 小心地 💡 考场思路not...entirely = 并非完全戒掉，与后面 but to reduce 对应。

entries.title: However, its 19 risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective.
entries.text: However, its 19 risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective. [A] promise 承诺 [B] competition 竞争 [C] experience 经历 [D] campaign 宣传运动 答案 D campaign Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be 16 up on Sunday alongside some steamed vegetables, without the Yorkshire pudding and no wine. But would life be worth living? 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to reduce their lifetime intake. However, its 19 risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective. Constant health scares just 20 with no one listening. [A] promise 承诺 [B] competition 竞争 [C] experience 经历 [D] campaign 宣传运动 💡 考场思路FSA这场健康"宣传活动"有咄咄逼人之嫌。

entries.title: Constant health scares just 20 with no one listening.
entries.text: Constant health scares just 20 with no one listening. [A] follow up 跟进 [B] end up 最终 [C] open up 打开 [D] pick up 捡起 答案 B end up Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be 16 up on Sunday alongside some steamed vegetables, without the Yorkshire pudding and no wine. But would life be worth living? 17, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods 18, but to reduce their lifetime intake. However, its 19 risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective. Constant health scares just 20 with no one listening. [A] follow up 跟进 [B] end up 最终 [C] open up 打开 [D] pick up 捡起 💡 考场思路没完没了的健康恐吓"最终"落得无人理睬。end up doing = 最终……。 ⚠️ 完形总结本文批判FSA的过度健康警告。抓让步对比（While/no conclusive evidence）和作者的讽刺语气。

entries.title: Cooper and her colleagues argue that a "town of culture" award could ___.
entries.text: Cooper and her colleagues argue that a "town of culture" award could ___. [A] consolidate the town-city ties in Britain. 巩固英国城镇与城市间的联系。 [B] promote cooperation among Britain's towns. 促进英国各城镇间的合作。 [C] increase the economic strength of Britain's towns. [D] focus Britain's limited resources on cultural events. 把英国有限的资源集中用于文化活动。 答案 C Cooper and her colleagues argue that a "town of culture" award could ___.Cooper和她的同事认为， “文化之城”奖可以___。 [A] consolidate the town-city ties in Britain.巩固英国城镇与城市间的联系。 [B] promote cooperation among Britain's towns.促进英国各城镇间的合作。 [C] increase the economic strength of Britain's towns. [D] focus Britain's limited resources on cultural events.把英国有限的资源集中用于文化活动。 💡 考场思路首段末：attracting funding and creating jobs——吸引资金、创造就业，即增强小镇经济实力。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 2, the proposal might be regarded by some as ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 2, the proposal might be regarded by some as ___. [A] a sensible compromise. 一个明智的折中。 [B] a self-deceiving attempt. [C] an eye-catching bonus. 引人注目的奖金。 [D] an inaccessible target. 一个难以企及的目标。 答案 B According to Paragraph 2, the proposal might be regarded by some as ___.根据第2款，该建议可能被一些人视为___。 [A] a sensible compromise.一个明智的折中。 [B] a self-deceiving attempt. [C] an eye-catching bonus.引人注目的奖金。 [D] an inaccessible target.一个难以企及的目标。 💡 考场思路第二段讽刺：安慰奖、自我庆祝狂热、文化村庄/郊区——即自欺欺人的尝试。

entries.title: The author suggests that a title holder is successful only if it ___.
entries.text: The author suggests that a title holder is successful only if it ___. [A] endeavours to maintain its image. 努力维护其形象。 [B] meets the aspirations of its people. 契合人民的愿望。 [C] brings its local arts to prominence. 使其地方艺术崭露头角。 [D] commits to its long-term growth. 答案 D The author suggests that a title holder is successful only if it ___.作者建议，只有在___的情况下，所有权持有者才会成功。 [A] endeavours to maintain its image.努力维护其形象。 [B] meets the aspirations of its people.契合人民的愿望。 [C] brings its local arts to prominence.使其地方艺术崭露头角。 [D] commits to its long-term growth. 💡 考场思路第三段批评糟糕的文化年"不留持久益处"，赞扬成功者改变居民抱负、推动城市长期形象——即致力于长期发展。

entries.title: Glasgow is mentioned in Paragraph 3 to present ___.
entries.text: Glasgow is mentioned in Paragraph 3 to present ___. [A] a contrasting case. 一个对比的案例。 [B] a supporting example. [C] a background story. 背景故事。 [D] a related topic. 一个相关话题。 答案 B Glasgow is mentioned in Paragraph 3 to present ___.第3段至第___段提到了格拉斯哥。 [A] a contrasting case.一个对比的案例。 [B] a supporting example. [C] a background story.背景故事。 [D] a related topic.一个相关话题。 💡 考场思路Glasgow 证明"这是可以做到的"——是支持作者观点的正面例子。

entries.title: What is the author's attitude towards the proposal?
entries.text: What is the author's attitude towards the proposal? [A] Skeptical. 怀疑的。 [B] Objective. 客观的。 [C] Favourable. [D] Critical. 批判的；关键的。 答案 C What is the author's attitude towards the proposal?作者对提案的态度是什么？ [A] Skeptical.怀疑的。 [B] Objective.客观的。 [C] Favourable. [D] Critical.批判的；关键的。 💡 考场思路末段作者称这是"positive, hope-filled proposal"，呼吁文化大臣付诸行动——支持态度。 核心词汇 institute v. 设立 avalanche n. 大量/雪崩 prestigious adj. 有声望的 cynic n. 愤世嫉俗者 cure-all n. 万灵药 nudge v. 推动

entries.title: Scientific publishing is seen as "a licence to print money" partly because ___.
entries.text: Scientific publishing is seen as "a licence to print money" partly because ___. [A] its funding has enjoyed a steady increase. 其资金持续稳步增长。 [B] its marketing strategy has been successful. 其营销策略一直成功。 [C] its payment for peer review is reduced. 其支付的同行评审费用减少了。 [D] its content acquisition costs nothing. 答案 D Scientific publishing is seen as "a licence to print money" partly because ___.科学出版被视为“印钞的许可证” ，部分原因是___。 [A] its funding has enjoyed a steady increase.其资金持续稳步增长。 [B] its marketing strategy has been successful.其营销策略一直成功。 [C] its payment for peer review is reduced.其支付的同行评审费用减少了。 [D] its content acquisition costs nothing. 💡 考场思路首段：科学家无偿供稿、同行评审也免费——获取内容零成本，所以是印钞机。

entries.title: According to Paragraphs 2 and 3, scientific publishers like Elsevier have ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraphs 2 and 3, scientific publishers like Elsevier have ___. [A] thrived mainly on university libraries. [B] gone through an existential crisis. 经历了一场生存危机。 [C] revived the publishing industry. 复兴了出版业。 [D] financed researchers generously. 慷慨资助研究人员。 答案 A According to Paragraphs 2 and 3, scientific publishers like Elsevier have ___.根据第2段和第3段，像爱思唯尔这样的科学出版商有___。 [A] thrived mainly on university libraries. [B] gone through an existential crisis.经历了一场生存危机。 [C] revived the publishing industry.复兴了出版业。 [D] financed researchers generously.慷慨资助研究人员。 💡 考场思路第二段说大学图书馆曾对价格不敏感；第三段说英国大学花2.1亿英镑买自己的研究——出版商主要靠大学图书馆牟利。

entries.title: How does the author feel about the success of Sci-Hub?
entries.text: How does the author feel about the success of Sci-Hub? [A] Relieved. 宽慰的；放心的。 [B] Puzzled. 困惑的。 [C] Concerned. [D] Encouraged. 受到鼓舞的。 答案 C How does the author feel about the success of Sci-Hub?作者对Sci-Hub的成功有何看法？ [A] Relieved.宽慰的；放心的。 [B] Puzzled.困惑的。 [C] Concerned. [D] Encouraged.受到鼓舞的。 💡 考场思路作者称Sci-Hub是"thoroughly illegal"，它的成功说明合法系统失去正当性——作者对此感到担忧。

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraphs 5 and 6 that open access terms ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraphs 5 and 6 that open access terms ___. [A] allow publishers some room to make money. [B] render publishing much easier for scientists. 使科学家出版大为便利。 [C] reduce the cost of publication substantially. 大幅降低出版成本。 [D] free universities from financial burdens. 让大学摆脱财务负担。 答案 A It can be learned from Paragraphs 5 and 6 that open access terms ___.从第5段和第6段可以了解到，开放获取条款___。 [A] allow publishers some room to make money. [B] render publishing much easier for scientists.使科学家出版大为便利。 [C] reduce the cost of publication substantially.大幅降低出版成本。 [D] free universities from financial burdens.让大学摆脱财务负担。 💡 考场思路第五段：付费墙保留一年多"so that the publishers can make a profit"；第六段：向作者收版面费——开放获取仍给出版商留了赚钱空间。

entries.title: Which of the following characterises the scientific publishing model?
entries.text: Which of the following characterises the scientific publishing model? [A] Trial subscription is offered. 提供试用订阅。 [B] Labour triumphs over status. 劳工胜过地位。 [C] Costs are well controlled. 成本得到良好控制。 [D] The few feed on the many. 答案 D Which of the following characterises the scientific publishing model?以下哪项是科学出版模式的特征？ [A] Trial subscription is offered.提供试用订阅。 [B] Labour triumphs over status.劳工胜过地位。 [C] Costs are well controlled.成本得到良好控制。 [D] The few feed on the many. 💡 考场思路末段：劳动免费，少数大公司赚巨额利润——即少数人靠多数人养活。 核心词汇 peer review 同行评审 profit margin 利润率 paywalled adj. 付费墙的 legitimacy n. 正当性 open access 开放获取 rebalancing n. 再平衡

entries.title: The author believes that the bills sponsored by Lewis and Haddad will ___.
entries.text: The author believes that the bills sponsored by Lewis and Haddad will ___. [A] help little to reduce gender bias. [B] pose a threat to the state government. 对州政府构成威胁。 [C] raise women's position in politics. 提升女性在政治中的地位。 [D] greatly broaden career options. 大幅拓宽职业选择。 答案 A The author believes that the bills sponsored by Lewis and Haddad will ___.作者认为，由Lewis和Haddad发起的法案将___。 [A] help little to reduce gender bias. [B] pose a threat to the state government.对州政府构成威胁。 [C] raise women's position in politics.提升女性在政治中的地位。 [D] greatly broaden career options.大幅拓宽职业选择。 💡 考场思路首段和末段都说这类政策只让特权者受益、对普通女性帮助甚微——即对减少性别偏见作用不大。

entries.title: Which of the following is true of the California measure?
entries.text: Which of the following is true of the California measure? [A] It has irritated private business owners. 它激怒了私人企业主。 [B] It is welcomed by the Supreme Court. 它受到最高法院欢迎。 [C] It may go against the Constitution. [D] It will settle the prior controversies. 它将解决此前的争议。 答案 C Which of the following is true of the California measure?对于加利福尼亚州的措施，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] It has irritated private business owners.它激怒了私人企业主。 [B] It is welcomed by the Supreme Court.它受到最高法院欢迎。 [C] It may go against the Constitution. [D] It will settle the prior controversies.它将解决此前的争议。 💡 考场思路第四段州长承认该法"probably unconstitutional"，第五段法院可能裁定其违反平等保护——即可能违宪。

entries.title: The author mentions the study by Catalyst to illustrate ___.
entries.text: The author mentions the study by Catalyst to illustrate ___. [A] the harm from arbitrary board decision. 武断的董事会决策带来的危害。 [B] the importance of constitutional guarantees. 宪法保障的重要性。 [C] the pressure on women in global corporations. 全球企业女性面临的压力。 [D] the needlessness of government interventions. 答案 D The author mentions the study by Catalyst to illustrate ___.作者提到了Catalyst的研究，以说明___。 [A] the harm from arbitrary board decision.武断的董事会决策带来的危害。 [B] the importance of constitutional guarantees.宪法保障的重要性。 [C] the pressure on women in global corporations.全球企业女性面临的压力。 [D] the needlessness of government interventions. 💡 考场思路Catalyst研究表明：没有政府干预，女性董事比例也涨了54%——即政府干预毫无必要。

entries.title: Norway's adoption of a nationwide corporate gender quota has led to ___.
entries.text: Norway's adoption of a nationwide corporate gender quota has led to ___. [A] the underestimation of elite women's role. 对精英女性角色的低估。 [B] the objection to female participation on boards. 对女性在董事会任职的反对。 [C] the entry of unqualified candidates into the board. [D] the growing tension between labor and management. 劳资之间日益紧张的关系。 答案 C Norway's adoption of a nationwide corporate gender quota has led to ___.挪威在全国范围内采用企业性别配额，导致___。 [A] the underestimation of elite women's role.对精英女性角色的低估。 [B] the objection to female participation on boards.对女性在董事会任职的反对。 [C] the entry of unqualified candidates into the board. [D] the growing tension between labor and management.劳资之间日益紧张的关系。 💡 考场思路第八段：把性别作为首要资历会"lead to less experienced boards"——即不合格者进入董事会。

entries.title: Which of the following can be inferred from the text?
entries.text: Which of the following can be inferred from the text? [A] Women's needs in employment should be considered. 女性在就业中的需求应被考虑。 [B] Feasibility should be a prime concern in policymaking. [C] Everyone should try hard to promote social justice. 人人都应努力促进社会公平。 [D] Major social issues should be the focus of legislation. 重大社会问题应成为立法重点。 答案 B Which of the following can be inferred from the text?从文本中可以推断出以下哪项？ [A] Women's needs in employment should be considered.女性在就业中的需求应被考虑。 [B] Feasibility should be a prime concern in policymaking. [C] Everyone should try hard to promote social justice.人人都应努力促进社会公平。 [D] Major social issues should be the focus of legislation.重大社会问题应成为立法重点。 💡 考场思路作者批评性别配额：违宪、导致不合格者、金色裙摆——政策应务实可行，而非空喊平等。 核心词汇 diversity mandate 多样性强制规定 virtue-signaling n. 道德标榜 gender parity 性别平等 unconstitutional adj. 违宪的 quota n. 配额 self-serving adj. 自利的

entries.title: The French Senate has passed a bill to ___.
entries.text: The French Senate has passed a bill to ___. [A] regulate digital services platforms. 监管数字服务平台。 [B] impose a levy on tech multinationals. [C] protect French companies' interests. 保护法国公司的利益。 [D] curb the influence of advertising. 遏制广告的影响。 答案 B The French Senate has passed a bill to ___.法国参议院已向___通过了一项法案。 [A] regulate digital services platforms.监管数字服务平台。 [B] impose a levy on tech multinationals. [C] protect French companies' interests.保护法国公司的利益。 [D] curb the influence of advertising.遏制广告的影响。 💡 考场思路首段：对大型跨国公司征收全新数字服务税。impose a levy = 征税。

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraph 2 that the digital services tax ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraph 2 that the digital services tax ___. [A] will prompt the tech giants to quit France. 将促使科技巨头退出法国。 [B] aims to ease international trade tensions. 旨在缓解国际贸易紧张。 [C] is apt to arouse criticism at home and abroad. 容易在国内外引发批评。 [D] may trigger countermeasures against France. 答案 D It can be learned from Paragraph 2 that the digital services tax ___.从第2款可以了解到，数字服务税___。 [A] will prompt the tech giants to quit France.将促使科技巨头退出法国。 [B] aims to ease international trade tensions.旨在缓解国际贸易紧张。 [C] is apt to arouse criticism at home and abroad.容易在国内外引发批评。 [D] may trigger countermeasures against France. 💡 考场思路第二段末：美国展开调查，可能导致对法国的贸易制裁——即可能引发反制措施。

entries.title: The countries adopting the unilateral measures share the opinion that ___.
entries.text: The countries adopting the unilateral measures share the opinion that ___. [A] the current international tax system needs upgrading. entries.title: With the Church's teachings and ways of thinking being eclipsed by the Renaissan
entries.text: With the Church's teachings and ways of thinking being eclipsed by the Renaissance, the gap between the Medieval and modern periods had been bridged, leading to new and unexplored intellectual territories. With the Church's teachings and ways of thinking being eclipsed by the Renaissance, the gap between the Medieval and modern periods had been bridged, leading to new and unexplored intellectual territories. 随着教会的教义和思维方式因文艺复兴而黯然失色，中世纪与近代之间的鸿沟得以弥合，从而开辟出全新的、尚未探索的知识领域。 采分点① eclipse 使黯然失色；② bridge the gap 弥合鸿沟；③ leading to 现在分词作结果；④ unexplored territories 未探索领域。

entries.title: Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more a
entries.text: Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking, including the geo-centric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe. Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking, including the geo-centric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe. 在他们各自做出重大发现之前，当时的许多思想家一直沿用更为古老的思维方式，其中就包括"地球处于宇宙中心"的地心说。 采分点① revelation 启示/重大发现；② sustain 维持/沿用；③ geo-centric view 地心说；④ 同位语从句的处理。

entries.title: Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and
entries.text: Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists, more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no longer ignore. Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists, more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no longer ignore. 尽管教会试图压制这新一代逻辑学家和理性主义者，但关于宇宙如何运行的新解释仍在不断涌现，其速度之快已让人们无法再忽视。 采分点① suppress 镇压/压制；② rationalist 理性主义者；③ at a rate that 以……速度；④ 被动语态的中文处理。

entries.title: As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philoso
entries.text: As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era — the Age of Reason. As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era — the Age of Reason. 当许多人承担起将理性和科学哲学融入现实世界的重任时，文艺复兴便告结束，一个新时代——理性时代——到来了。 采分点① take on the duty 承担责任；② integrate…into 把……融入；③ it was time for 是……的时候了。

entries.title: Such actions to seek knowledge and to understand what information we already kne
entries.text: Such actions to seek knowledge and to understand what information we already knew were captured by the Latin phrase 'sapere aude' or 'dare to know', after Immanuel Kant used it in his essay "An Answer to the Question: What is Enlightenment?". Such actions to seek knowledge and to understand what information we already knew were captured by the Latin phrase 'sapere aude' or 'dare to know', after Immanuel Kant used it in his essay "An Answer to the Question: What is Enlightenment?". 这种追求知识、理解已知信息的行动，被概括为拉丁语箴言"sapere aude"，即"敢于求知"——这是伊曼努尔·康德在其文章《回答这个问题：什么是启蒙？》中所用的。 采分点① capture 概括/捕捉；② sapere aude 敢于求知（音译+意译）；③ after 此处意为"效仿/源自"；④ 书名号的使用。

entries.text: The Student Union has delegated you to notify international students of an upcoming singing contest. Write a notice of about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Part A 小作文（10分）— 通知 原题指令 Directions The Student Union has delegated you to notify international students of an upcoming singing contest. Write a notice of about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. 【译文】学生会委派你通知留学生即将举行一场歌唱比赛。写一则约100词的通知。通知末尾不要署自己的名字。 题目 校学生会委派你通知国际学生即将举办的歌唱比赛。写一则约100词的通知。落款不要用自己真名。 审题 ① 文体：通知（Notice）；② 内容：比赛时间、地点、参赛对象、报名方式；③ 语气：正式、清晰。 参考范文 Notice Aiming to enrich campus life and promote cultural exchange, the Students' Union will hold an English Singing Contest on the evening of December 25 in the University Hall. All international students are warmly welcome to participate. Each contestant may perform one English song, lasting no more than five minutes. Those interested are requested to sign up at the Students' Union office before December 18. Prizes will be awarded to the top three, and every participant will receive a souvenir. For further information, please contact us via the campus network. We look forward to your act

On the right, a chronic procrastinator sits idly before an empty desk, putting off all work until the last minute. entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text? entries.title: According to the first two paragraphs, CCT programs aim to ___.
entries.text: According to the first two paragraphs, CCT programs aim to ___. [A] help poor families get better off [B] facilitate health care reform 推动医疗改革 [C] improve local education systems 改善地方教育体系 [D] lower deforestation rates 降低森林砍伐率 答案 A According to the first two paragraphs, CCT programs aim to ___.根据前两段， CCT计划旨在___。 [A] help poor families get better off [B] facilitate health care reform推动医疗改革 [C] improve local education systems改善地方教育体系 [D] lower deforestation rates降低森林砍伐率 💡 考场思路第二段：CCT旨在减少不平等、打破贫困循环、提供食物药品——即帮贫困家庭改善生活。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 1, the author's posts on Twitter ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 1, the author's posts on Twitter ___. [A] illustrated the development of Victorian photography 展现了维多利亚时代摄影的发展 [B] highlighted social media's role in Victorian studies 凸显了社交媒体在维多利亚研究中的作用 [C] re-evaluated the Victorians' notion of public image 重新评价了维多利亚时代人对公众形象的观念 [D] changed people's impression of the Victorians 答案 D According to Paragraph 1, the author's posts on Twitter ___.根据第1段，作者在Twitter上的帖子___。 [A] illustrated the development of Victorian photography展现了维多利亚时代摄影的发展 [B] highlighted social media's role in Victorian studies凸显了社交媒体在维多利亚研究中的作用 [C] re-evaluated the Victorians' notion of public image重新评价了维多利亚时代人对公众形象的观念 [D] changed people's impression of the Victorians 💡 考场思路首段：人们惊讶地发现维多利亚人也会笑，他们"突然显得更像人"——即改变了对维多利亚人的刻板印象。

entries.text: What does the author say about the Victorian portraits he has collected? [A] They are rare among photographs of that age.
