[B] They show effects of different exposure times.它们展示了不同时长曝光的效果。 [C] They mirror 19th-century social conventions.它们折射出19世纪的社会习俗。 [D] They are in popular use among historians.它们在历史学家中普遍使用。 💡 考场思路第二段：微笑的维多利亚照片只占"tiny percentage"——即在那个年代的照片中很罕见。

entries.title: What might have kept the Victorians from smiling for pictures in the 1890s?
entries.text: What might have kept the Victorians from smiling for pictures in the 1890s? [A] Their inherent social sensitiveness. 它们固有的社会敏感性。 [B] Their tension before the camera. 他们在镜头前的紧张。 [C] Their unhealthy dental condition. [D] Their distrust of new inventions. 他们对新发明的不信任。 答案 C What might have kept the Victorians from smiling for pictures in the 1890s?是什么让维多利亚时代的人在19世纪90年代对图片保持微笑？ [A] Their inherent social sensitiveness.它们固有的社会敏感性。 [B] Their tension before the camera.他们在镜头前的紧张。 [C] Their unhealthy dental condition. [D] Their distrust of new inventions.他们对新发明的不信任。 💡 考场思路第五、六段：曝光已不是问题后，原因转向牙齿——口腔卫生差、牙齿发黑有缝，露齿笑不体面。

entries.title: Mark Twain is quoted to show that the disapproval of smiles in pictures was ___.
entries.text: Mark Twain is quoted to show that the disapproval of smiles in pictures was ___. [A] a thought-provoking idea 一个发人深省的观点 [B] a misguided attitude 一种被误导的态度 [C] a controversial view 一个有争议的观点 [D] a deep-rooted belief 答案 D Mark Twain is quoted to show that the disapproval of smiles in pictures was ___.引用马克·吐温的话来表明，图片中对微笑的不赞成是___。 [A] a thought-provoking idea一个发人深省的观点 [B] a misguided attitude一种被误导的态度 [C] a controversial view一个有争议的观点 [D] a deep-rooted belief 💡 考场思路连爱开怀大笑的马克·吐温都认为照片上的笑糟透了——说明对照片微笑的反感是根深蒂固的观念。

entries.title: Which of the following questions does the text answer?
entries.text: Which of the following questions does the text answer? [A] Why did most Victorians look stern in photographs? [B] When did the Victorians start to view photography differently? 维多利亚时代的人是何时开始以不同眼光看待摄影的？ [C] What made photography develop slowly in the Victorian period? 是什么让摄影在维多利亚时期发展缓慢？ [D] How did smiling in photographs become a post-Victorian norm? 照片中的微笑是如何成为后维多利亚时代规范的？ 答案 A Which of the following questions does the text answer?文本回答了以下哪些问题？ [A] Why did most Victorians look stern in photographs? [B] When did the Victorians start to view photography differently?维多利亚时代的人是何时开始以不同眼光看待摄影的？ [C] What made photography develop slowly in the Victorian period?是什么让摄影在维多利亚时期发展缓慢？ [D] How did smiling in photographs become a post-Victorian norm?照片中的微笑是如何成为后维多利亚时代规范的？ 💡 考场思路第二段末直接发问"How do we explain this trend?"（为什么维多利亚人拍照不笑），全文即回答此问。 核心词汇 preoccupied adj. 痴迷的 prudery n. 拘谨 concede v. 承认 daguerreotype n. 达盖尔银版法 dignity n. 体面/尊严 damning adj. 糟透的/定罪的

entries.title: There has long been concern that broadband providers would ___.
entries.text: There has long been concern that broadband providers would ___. [A] bring web-based firms under control 将网络公司置于管控之下 [B] slow down the traffic on their network 减缓其网络上的流量 [C] show partiality in treating clients [D] intensify competition with their rivals 加剧与对手的竞争 答案 C There has long been concern that broadband providers would ___.长期以来，人们一直担心宽带提供商会___。 [A] bring web-based firms under control将网络公司置于管控之下 [B] slow down the traffic on their network减缓其网络上的流量 [C] show partiality in treating clients [D] intensify competition with their rivals加剧与对手的竞争 💡 考场思路首段：担心宽带商有动机"favor affiliated websites over their rivals"——偏袒一部分客户。

entries.title: Faced with the demand for net neutrality rules, the FCC ___.
entries.text: Faced with the demand for net neutrality rules, the FCC ___. [A] sticks to an out-of-date order 固守一种过时的秩序 [B] takes an anti-regulatory stance [C] has issued a special resolution 已发布一项特别决议 [D] has allowed the states to intervene 已允许各州介入 答案 B Faced with the demand for net neutrality rules, the FCC ___.面对网络中立规则的需求， FCC ___。 [A] sticks to an out-of-date order固守一种过时的秩序 [B] takes an anti-regulatory stance [C] has issued a special resolution已发布一项特别决议 [D] has allowed the states to intervene已允许各州介入 💡 考场思路第二段：FCC 2017年废除严格的网络中立规则、否定自己的监管权——持反监管立场。

entries.title: What can be learned about AT&T from Paragraph 3?
entries.text: What can be learned about AT&T from Paragraph 3? [A] It protects against unfair competition. 它防范不公平竞争。 [B] It engages in anti-competitive practices. [C] It is under the FCC's investigation. 它正受到FCC的调查。 [D] It is in pursuit of quality service. 它追求高质量服务。 答案 B What can be learned about AT&T from Paragraph 3?关于AT&T ，可以从第3段中学到什么？ [A] It protects against unfair competition.它防范不公平竞争。 [B] It engages in anti-competitive practices. [C] It is under the FCC's investigation.它正受到FCC的调查。 [D] It is in pursuit of quality service.它追求高质量服务。 💡 考场思路第三段：AT&T偏袒自家流媒体、牺牲奈飞——这正是反竞争行为。

entries.title: Judge Patricia Millett argues that the appeals court's decision ___.
entries.text: Judge Patricia Millett argues that the appeals court's decision ___. [A] focuses on trivialities 纠结于细枝末节 [B] conveys an ambiguous message 传递出模棱两可的信息 [C] is at odds with its earlier rulings 与其早先的裁决相抵触 [D] is out of touch with reality 答案 D Judge Patricia Millett argues that the appeals court's decision ___.Patricia Millett法官辩称，上诉法院的裁决___。 [A] focuses on trivialities纠结于细枝末节 [B] conveys an ambiguous message传递出模棱两可的信息 [C] is at odds with its earlier rulings与其早先的裁决相抵触 [D] is out of touch with reality 💡 考场思路第四段：Millett说裁决"unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service"——脱离现实。

entries.title: What does the author argue in the last paragraph?
entries.text: What does the author argue in the last paragraph? [A] Congress needs to take action to ensure net neutrality. [B] The FCC should be put under strict supervision. FCC应受到严格监管。 [C] Rules need to be set to diversify online services. 需制定规则使在线服务多样化。 [D] Broadband providers' rights should be protected. 宽带提供商的权利应受保护。 答案 A What does the author argue in the last paragraph?作者在最后一段中提出了什么观点？ [A] Congress needs to take action to ensure net neutrality. [B] The FCC should be put under strict supervision.FCC应受到严格监管。 [C] Rules need to be set to diversify online services.需制定规则使在线服务多样化。 [D] Broadband providers' rights should be protected.宽带提供商的权利应受保护。 💡 考场思路末段首句：endless battles cry out for Congress to act——国会需采取行动。 核心词汇 net neutrality 网络中立 affiliated adj. 关联的 deregulate v. 放松监管 unanimously adv. 一致地 uphold v. 维持 meddle in 干预

entries.title: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roug
entries.text: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war. Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war. 这些经历了二战的国家，战前数十年适龄人口的高校入学率一直维持在3%至5%左右。 采分点① come out of the war 走出战争；② enrollment 入学率；③ roughly constant 大致稳定；④ relevant age groups 相关年龄组。

entries.title: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extend
entries.text: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war. And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war. 在这些国家里，接受高等教育的需求日益高涨，已扩展到战前从未想过接受大学教育的各个团体以及社会阶层。 采分点① demand that rose 高涨的需求；② entry to higher education 进入高等教育；③ extended to 扩展到；④ 两个定语从句的处理。

entries.title: In many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education
entries.text: In many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education doubled within five-year periods during the 1960s and doubled again in seven, eight, or 10 years by the middle of the 1970s. In many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education doubled within five-year periods during the 1960s and doubled again in seven, eight, or 10 years by the middle of the 1970s. 在西欧很多国家，20世纪60年代接受高等教育的学生数量在五年内增加了一倍。在20世纪70年代中期，又在七年、八年或十年内再次增倍。 采分点① double 翻番；② within five-year periods 五年之内；③ by the middle of the 1970s 到70年代中期。

entries.title: and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgrad
entries.text: and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study, they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty. and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study, they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty. 并且当新员工主要是刚毕业的研究生时，他们就在很大程度上确定了该院系学术生活的规范。 采分点① predominantly 主要地；② fresh from postgraduate study 刚从研究生毕业；③ define the norms 确立规范；④ faculty 院系。

entries.title: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weake
entries.text: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth. High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth. 高增长率增加了学术创新的机会，但它们也削弱了教师和学生在稳定期或缓慢增长期间被纳入学术团队的形式和过程。 采分点① academic innovation 学术创新；② weaken 削弱；③ be admitted into 被纳入；④ a community of scholars 学术共同体。

entries.title: One of your foreign friends has just graduated from college and intends to find
entries.text: One of your foreign friends has just graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write an email to give him/her some advice. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 求职建议邮件 原题指令 Directions One of your foreign friends has just graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write an email to give him/her some advice. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. 【译文】你的一位外国朋友刚从大学毕业，打算在中国找工作。写一封电子邮件给他/她提些建议。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。 题目 你的一位外国朋友刚大学毕业，打算在中国找工作。写一封邮件给他/她提些建议。约100词，落款用"Li Ming"。 审题 ① 文体：给朋友的建议邮件；② 内容：2-3条具体求职建议（如学汉语、利用校友网络、了解中国职场文化）；③ 语气：友好真诚。 参考范文 Dear Friend, Congratulations on your graduation! I was thrilled to hear that you plan to pursue your career in China, and I would like to offer some practical advice. First, if your Chinese is not yet fluent, an intensive language course will greatly broaden your job options. Second, consider leveraging your university's alumni network in cities like Shanghai or Shenzhen, where multinationals and start-ups are most active. Finally, it helps to familiarize yourself with local workplace culture, such as the emphasis on teamwork and personal connections. I would be delighted to introduce you

entries.title: The author suggests that generation Z should ___.
entries.text: The author suggests that generation Z should ___. [A] Be careful in choosing college 选择大学时要谨慎 [B] Be diligent at each educational stage 在每个教育阶段都要勤勉 [C] Reassess the necessity of college education [D] Postpone their undergraduate application 推迟他们的本科申请 答案 C The author suggests that generation Z should ___.作者建议Z世代应该___。 [A] Be careful in choosing college选择大学时要谨慎 [B] Be diligent at each educational stage在每个教育阶段都要勤勉 [C] Reassess the necessity of college education [D] Postpone their undergraduate application推迟他们的本科申请 💡 考场思路全文首句即主旨：学位的意义、目的和价值已经改变，Z世代需要重新审视大学教育的必要性。 逐项分析 [A] 谨慎选大学 → 偷换，不是选学校而是要不要上； [B] 每个教育阶段都勤奋 → 无中生有； [C] 重新评估大学教育必要性 → 正确； [D] 推迟本科申请 → 未提及。 核心词汇 millennial n. 千禧一代 devalue v. 贬值 social mobility 社会流动 generalist n. 通才 up-skill v. 提升技能 trajectory n. 轨迹

entries.title: The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects ___.
entries.text: The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects ___. [A] millennials' opinions about work 千禧一代对工作看法 [B] the shrinking value of degree [C] public discount with education 公众对教育的轻视 [D] the desired route of social mobility 期望的社会流动路径 答案 B The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects ___.英国毕业生担任非研究生职位的百分比反映了___。 [A] millennials' opinions about work千禧一代对工作看法 [B] the shrinking value of degree [C] public discount with education公众对教育的轻视 [D] the desired route of social mobility期望的社会流动路径 💡 考场思路第二段："As degrees became universal, they became devalued." 28%毕业生从事非毕业生岗位，正是学位贬值的体现。

entries.title: The author considers it a good sign that ___.
entries.text: The author considers it a good sign that ___. [A] Generation Z are seeking to earn a decent degree Z世代正努力获得一个体面的学位 [B] school leavers are willing to be skilled workers 离校生愿意成为技术工人 [C] employers are taking a realistic attitude to degrees [D] parents are changing their minds about education 父母正在改变对教育的看法 答案 C The author considers it a good sign that ___.作者认为这是一个好兆头，即___。 [A] Generation Z are seeking to earn a decent degreeZ世代正努力获得一个体面的学位 [B] school leavers are willing to be skilled workers离校生愿意成为技术工人 [C] employers are taking a realistic attitude to degrees [D] parents are changing their minds about education父母正在改变对教育的看法 💡 考场思路第四段 Thankfully 后面：雇主看到招聘中学毕业生的好处、取消某些岗位学位要求——这是雇主对学位采取务实态度的好迹象。

entries.title: It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should ___.
entries.text: It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should ___. [A] make an early decision on their career 尽早对职业做出决定 [B] attend on-the-job training programs 参加在职培训项目 [C] team up with high-paid post graduates 与高薪研究生合作 [D] further their studies in the specific field 答案 D It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should ___.在第5段中，建议具有一个学位的人应___。 [A] make an early decision on their career尽早对职业做出决定 [B] attend on-the-job training programs参加在职培训项目 [C] team up with high-paid post graduates与高薪研究生合作 [D] further their studies in the specific field 💡 考场思路第五段末："it makes sense to have two"——再读一个学位，即在特定领域继续深造。

entries.title: What can be concluded about Generation Z from last two paragraphs?
entries.text: What can be concluded about Generation Z from last two paragraphs? [A] Lifelong learning will define them. [B] They will make qualified educators. 他们将能成为合格的教育者。 [C] Degrees will no longer appeal to them. 学位将不再吸引他们。 [D] They will have a limited choice of jobs. 他们将只有有限的就业选择。 答案 A What can be concluded about Generation Z from last two paragraphs?从最后两段可以得出什么关于Z世代的结论？ [A] Lifelong learning will define them. [B] They will make qualified educators.他们将能成为合格的教育者。 [C] Degrees will no longer appeal to them.学位将不再吸引他们。 [D] They will have a limited choice of jobs.他们将只有有限的就业选择。 💡 考场思路倒数第二段："they will need to be constantly up-skilling throughout their career"——不断提升技能=终身学习定义他们。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 1, art-science collaborations have ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 1, art-science collaborations have ___. [A] caught the attention of critics 引起了评论家的注意 [B] received favorable responses [C] promoted academic publishing 推动了学术出版 [D] sparked heated public disputes 引发了激烈的社会争论 答案 B According to Paragraph 1, art-science collaborations have ___.根据第1段，艺术-科学合作有___。 [A] caught the attention of critics引起了评论家的注意 [B] received favorable responses [C] promoted academic publishing推动了学术出版 [D] sparked heated public disputes引发了激烈的社会争论 💡 考场思路第一段用 Enlightening, stimulating, inspiring, fun 等正面词描述合作体验，近40%的人合作过，几乎所有人未来愿意合作——积极回应。 逐项分析 [A] 引起批评家注意 → 未提 critics； [B] 获得积极回应 → 正确； [C] 促进学术出版 → 未提及； [D] 引发公众争论 → 与 encouraging 相反。 核心词汇 collaboration n. 合作 engage v. 参与 two-way street 双向的 shared stake 共同利益 alliance n. 联盟 stereotype v. 刻板印象

entries.title: The reworked version of The Four Seasons is mentioned to show that ___.
entries.text: The reworked version of The Four Seasons is mentioned to show that ___. [A] art can offer audiences easy access to science [B] science can help with the expression of emotions 科学有助于情感的表达 [C] public participation in science has a promising future 公众参与科学前景可期 [D] art is effective in facilitating scientific innovation 艺术能有效促进科学创新 答案 A The reworked version of The Four Seasons is mentioned to show that ___.提到了《四季》的翻新版本，以表明___。 [A] art can offer audiences easy access to science [B] science can help with the expression of emotions科学有助于情感的表达 [C] public participation in science has a promising future公众参与科学前景可期 [D] art is effective in facilitating scientific innovation艺术能有效促进科学创新 💡 考场思路例证题找论点。第二段论点：科学家找艺术家帮助"communicate their work to new audiences"。用维瓦尔第《四季》改编注入气候数据，正是艺术让公众接触科学。 逐项分析 [A] 艺术让观众轻松接触科学 → 正确； [B] 科学帮助表达情感 → 与文意相反； [C] 公众参与科学前景光明 → 偷换； [D] 艺术促进科学创新 → 未提及。

entries.title: Some artists seem to worry that in the art-science partnership ___.
entries.text: Some artists seem to worry that in the art-science partnership ___. [A] their roles may be underestimated [B] their reputation may be impaired 他们的声誉可能受损 [C] their creativity may be inhibited 他们的创造力可能受抑制 [D] their work may be misguided 他们的工作可能受到误导 答案 A Some artists seem to worry that in the art-science partnership ___.一些艺术家似乎担心在艺术-科学伙伴关系中___。 [A] their roles may be underestimated [B] their reputation may be impaired他们的声誉可能受损 [C] their creativity may be inhibited他们的创造力可能受抑制 [D] their work may be misguided他们的工作可能受到误导 💡 考场思路第四段："artists do not simply assist scientists... Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study"——艺术家担心自己只是助手、作品只是研究对象，即角色被低估。

entries.title: What does the author say about CAVS?
entries.text: What does the author say about CAVS? [A] It was headed alternately by artists and scientists. 它由艺术家和科学家交替领导。 [B] It exemplified valuable art-science alliances. [C] Its projects aimed at advancing visual studies. 其旨在推进视觉研究的项目。 [D] Its founders sought to raise the status of artists. 其创始人试图提升艺术家的地位。 答案 B What does the author say about CAVS?作者对CAVS有什么看法？ [A] It was headed alternately by artists and scientists.它由艺术家和科学家交替领导。 [B] It exemplified valuable art-science alliances. [C] Its projects aimed at advancing visual studies.其旨在推进视觉研究的项目。 [D] Its founders sought to raise the status of artists.其创始人试图提升艺术家的地位。 💡 考场思路第五段讲CAVS由艺术家和科学家共同创建，致力于创造更人道世界——这是有价值的艺术-科学联盟的典范。

entries.title: In the last paragraph, the author holds art-science collaborations ___.
entries.text: In the last paragraph, the author holds art-science collaborations ___. [A] are likely to go beyond public expectations 可能超出公众预期 [B] will intensify interdisciplinary competition 将加剧跨学科竞争 [C] should do more than communicating science [D] are becoming more popular than before 正变得比以前更受欢迎 答案 C In the last paragraph, the author holds art-science collaborations ___.在最后一段中，作者持有艺术-科学合作___。 [A] are likely to go beyond public expectations可能超出公众预期 [B] will intensify interdisciplinary competition将加剧跨学科竞争 [C] should do more than communicating science [D] are becoming more popular than before正变得比以前更受欢迎 💡 考场思路末段首句："The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication"——合作应超越研究传播的目的，即做更多事。

entries.title: The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ___.
entries.text: The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ___. [A] punish dubious corporate practices 惩处可疑的企业行为 [B] improve traditional hiring procedures 改进传统的招聘流程。 [C] exempt employers from certain duties 使雇主免除某些义务 [D] protect the rights of ordinary workers 答案 D The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ___.ERA的个人申诉条款旨在___。 [A] punish dubious corporate practices惩处可疑的企业行为 [B] improve traditional hiring procedures改进传统的招聘流程。 [C] exempt employers from certain duties使雇主免除某些义务 [D] protect the rights of ordinary workers 💡 考场思路第二段首句："Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from 'unjustified dismissals'." 保护普通工人工作。 逐项分析 [A] 惩罚可疑企业行为 → 未提及； [B] 改善传统招聘流程 → 与 firing 无关； [C] 免除雇主义务 → 与文意相反； [D] 保护普通工人权利 → 正确。 核心词汇 grievance n. 申诉/不满 arbitrary adj. 任意的 mediocrity n. 平庸 paradox n. 悖论 stringent adj. 严格的 unwieldy adj. 难操作的

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that the provision may ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that the provision may ___. [A] hinder business development [B] undermine the managers' authorities 削弱经理人的权威 [C] affect the public image of the firms 影响企业的公众形象 [D] weaken the labor-management relations 削弱劳资关系 答案 A It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that the provision may ___.从第3款中可以了解到，该条款可以___。 [A] hinder business development [B] undermine the managers' authorities削弱经理人的权威 [C] affect the public image of the firms影响企业的公众形象 [D] weaken the labor-management relations削弱劳资关系 💡 考场思路第三段："constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity"——限制解雇差经理就像踩手刹，阻碍生产率提高，即阻碍企业发展。

entries.title: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?
entries.text: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support? [A] Imposing reasonable wage restraints. 施加合理的工资限制。 [B] Enforcing employment protections. 执行就业保护。 [C] Limiting the powers of business owners. 限制企业主的权力。 [D] Dismissing poorly performing managers. 答案 D Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?生产力委员会将支持以下哪些措施？ [A] Imposing reasonable wage restraints.施加合理的工资限制。 [B] Enforcing employment protections.执行就业保护。 [C] Limiting the powers of business owners.限制企业主的权力。 [D] Dismissing poorly performing managers. 💡 考场思路第五段：生产力委员会指出管理能力低下是生产率差的原因。言下之意，应该解雇表现差的经理。

entries.title: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedure?
entries.text: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedure? [A] High-paid managers may lose jobs. 高薪经理可能失去工作。 [B] Employees suffer salary cut. [C] Society sees a rise in well-being. 社会福祉有所提升。 [D] Employers hire more staff. 雇主雇佣更多员工。 答案 B What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedure?ERA 的不当驳回程序可能会产生什么影响？ [A] High-paid managers may lose jobs.高薪经理可能失去工作。 [B] Employees suffer salary cut. [C] Society sees a rise in well-being.社会福祉有所提升。 [D] Employers hire more staff.雇主雇佣更多员工。 💡 考场思路第六段末："firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong"——公司给员工工资更低。

entries.title: It can be inferred that "high-income threshold" in Australia ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred that "high-income threshold" in Australia ___. [A] has secured managers' earnings 已锁定经理人的收益 [B] has produced undesired results 产生了事与愿违的结果 [C] is beneficial to business owners 对企业主有益 [D] is difficult to put into practice 答案 D It can be inferred that "high-income threshold" in Australia ___.可以推断，澳大利亚的“高收入门槛” ___。 [A] has secured managers' earnings已锁定经理人的收益 [B] has produced undesired results产生了事与愿违的结果 [C] is beneficial to business owners对企业主有益 [D] is difficult to put into practice 💡 考场思路最后一段：新西兰试图效仿澳大利亚做法，但"the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy"（提出的机制难以操作），法案被否决——暗指澳大利亚的高收入门槛在实践中也难以操作。

entries.title: 【题目】阅读关于"反对动物园"文章的五位评论者观点，从A–G中为(41)–(45)匹配观点。两个多余选项。
entries.text: 【题目】阅读关于"反对动物园"文章的五位评论者观点，从A–G中为(41)–(45)匹配观点。两个多余选项。 答案 F 【题目】阅读关于"反对动物园"文章的五位评论者观点，从A–G中为(41)–(45)匹配观点。两个多余选项。 匹配[F] 动物园应该被关闭，因为它们把赚钱置于动物福祉之上。→ 对应Byrd说"profitable institutions whose bottom line is much more important"和"eliminate zoos from our culture"。 Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G AZoos which spare no effort to take care of animals should not be subjected to unfair criticism.不遗余力照料动物的动物园，不应遭受不公正的批评。 BTo pressure zoos to spend less on their animals would lead to inhumane outcomes for the precious creatures in their care.迫使动物园减少对动物的投入，会给它们所照管的珍贵生灵带来不人道的后果。 CWhile animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.尽管圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人走上相关科学之路上发挥着重要作用。 DZoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.动物园让人们省去前往荒野的奔波，从而有助于野生动物保护。 EFor wild

You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows two students in front of a campus billboard advertising lectures. A girl says, "They're not related to our major, so they won't help." A boy says, "Go and listen; it'll surely do you good." Part B 大作文（20分）— 图画作文 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows two students in front of a campus billboard advertising lectures. A girl says, "They're not related to our major, so they won't help." A boy says, "Go and listen; it'll surely do you good." 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 漫画中校园讲座广告牌前，两名学生对话。女生说：“不是我们一个专业的，听了也没有多大用。”男生说：“去听一下，肯定有好处。” 题目 图画：校园讲座广告牌前，两个学生对话。女生说："不是我们一个专业的，听了也没有多大用。"男生说："去听一下，肯定有好处。"要求：简要描述图画、阐释含义、给出评论。160-200词。 审题框架 三段式：①描述图画（两种对待跨专业讲座的态度）；②阐释含义（大学生应广泛涉猎知识而非局限本专业）；③评论（跨学科知识的重要性）。 参考范文 The cartoon captures a familiar campus scene. In front of a billboard advertising various lectures, a girl complains to her friend, "They're not related to our major, so they won't help our study." Her companion replies, "Go and listen; there's bound to be some benefit." Simple as it is, the picture reflects a prevalent mindset: some students limit themselves strictly to their own discipline and dismiss knowledge from other fields. Yet in an era of rapid change, those with broad horizons and multiple skills adapt far better and prove more competitive. As the saying go

[A] believed 相信 [B] predicted 据推测/估计 [C] recalled 回忆 [D] implied 暗示 答案 B predicted Caravanserais were also an important marketplace for commodities and 15 in the trade of goods along the Silk Road. 16, it was frequently the first stop merchants looking to sell their wares and 17 supplies for their own journeys. It is 18 that around 120000 to 150000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, 19 only about 3000 are known to remain today, many of which are in 20. [A] believed 相信 [B] predicted 据推测/估计 [C] recalled 回忆 [D] implied 暗示 💡 考场思路It is predicted that... 据估计，曾修建了12-15万座驿站。

entries.title: It is 18 that around 120000 to 150000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Ro
entries.text: It is 18 that around 120000 to 150000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, 19 only about 3000 are known to remain today, many of which are in 20. [A] until 直到 [B] because 因为 [C] unless 除非 [D] although 尽管 答案 D although Caravanserais were also an important marketplace for commodities and 15 in the trade of goods along the Silk Road. 16, it was frequently the first stop merchants looking to sell their wares and 17 supplies for their own journeys. It is 18 that around 120000 to 150000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, 19 only about 3000 are known to remain today, many of which are in 20. [A] until 直到 [B] because 因为 [C] unless 除非 [D] although 尽管 💡 考场思路曾经12-15万座，"尽管"如今仅存约3000座。让步转折。

entries.title: It is 18 that around 120000 to 150000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Ro
entries.text: It is 18 that around 120000 to 150000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, 19 only about 3000 are known to remain today, many of which are in 20. [A] ruins 废墟 [B] debt 债务 [C] fashion 时尚 [D] series 系列 答案 A ruins Caravanserais were also an important marketplace for commodities and 15 in the trade of goods along the Silk Road. 16, it was frequently the first stop merchants looking to sell their wares and 17 supplies for their own journeys. It is 18 that around 120000 to 150000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, 19 only about 3000 are known to remain today, many of which are in 20. [A] ruins 废墟 [B] debt 债务 [C] fashion 时尚 [D] series 系列 💡 考场思路现存的3000座中许多已成"废墟"。in ruins = 成废墟。 ⚠️ 完形总结本文介绍丝绸之路商队驿站。逻辑链：定义→词源→功能（安全休息）→文化交流→贸易→现存状况。重点抓 so that/as a result/although 等逻辑词。

entries.title: In Paragraph 1, the weather in Texas is mentioned to ___.
entries.text: In Paragraph 1, the weather in Texas is mentioned to ___. [A] forecast a policy shift in Texas schools. 预测得州学校政策的转向。 [B] stress the consequences of climate change 强调气候变化的后果 [C] indicate the atmosphere at the board meeting [D] draw the public's attention to energy shortages. 引起公众对能源短缺的关注。 答案 C In Paragraph 1, the weather in Texas is mentioned to ___.在第1款中，德克萨斯州的天气被提到___。 [A] forecast a policy shift in Texas schools.预测得州学校政策的转向。 [B] stress the consequences of climate change强调气候变化的后果 [C] indicate the atmosphere at the board meeting [D] draw the public's attention to energy shortages.引起公众对能源短缺的关注。 💡 考场思路第一段用天气cooled but temperature will be high作比喻——天气转凉了，但会议上"温度"（气氛）会很高。indicate atmosphere。 逐项分析 [A] 预测政策转变 → 不是举例目的； [B] 强调气候变化后果 → 偷换； [C] 暗示校董会议的热烈气氛 → 正确； [D] 引起公众对能源短缺关注 → 无中生有。 核心词汇 sympathize with 同情 mitigation n. 减缓 dispute v. 质疑 ideology n. 意识形态 benchmark n. 基准 slanted adj. 偏激的

entries.title: What does Quinn think of Hardy?
entries.text: What does Quinn think of Hardy? [A] she exaggerates the existing panic. 她夸大了当下的恐慌。 [B] she denies the value of scientific work [C] she shows no concern for pre-teens. 她对青春期前儿童毫不关心。 [D] she expresses self-contradictory views. 她表达了自相矛盾的看法。 答案 B What does Quinn think of Hardy?奎因对哈代有什么看法？ [A] she exaggerates the existing panic.她夸大了当下的恐慌。 [B] she denies the value of scientific work [C] she shows no concern for pre-teens.她对青春期前儿童毫不关心。 [D] she expresses self-contradictory views.她表达了自相矛盾的看法。 💡 考场思路第三段："They casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion"——哈迪把科学家的毕生工作贬为被误导的观点，即否定科学工作的价值。

entries.title: The study mentioned in Paragraph 5 shows that ___.
entries.text: The study mentioned in Paragraph 5 shows that ___. [A] climate education is insufficient at state public schools. [B] policy makers have little drive for science education. 决策者对科学教育缺乏动力。 [C] Texas is reluctant to rewrite its science textbooks. 得州不愿重写其科学教材。 [D] environmental teaching in some states lacks supervision. 一些州的环境教学缺乏监管。 答案 A The study mentioned in Paragraph 5 shows that ___.第5段提到的研究表明___。 [A] climate education is insufficient at state public schools. [B] policy makers have little drive for science education.决策者对科学教育缺乏动力。 [C] Texas is reluctant to rewrite its science textbooks.得州不愿重写其科学教材。 [D] environmental teaching in some states lacks supervision.一些州的环境教学缺乏监管。 💡 考场思路第五段：仅不到一半州获B+以上，得州获F——说明气候教育不充分。

entries.title: According to Branch, state-level science standards in the US ___.
entries.text: According to Branch, state-level science standards in the US ___. [A] call for regular revision 要求定期修订 [B] require urgent application 需要紧急应用 [C] have limited influence [D] cater to local needs 满足当地需求 答案 C According to Branch, state-level science standards in the US ___.根据Branch的说法，美国的州级科学标准___。 [A] call for regular revision要求定期修订 [B] require urgent application需要紧急应用 [C] have limited influence [D] cater to local needs满足当地需求 💡 考场思路第六段："setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark"——只是有限的基准，即影响力有限。

entries.title: It is implied in the last paragraph that climate change teaching in some schools
entries.text: It is implied in the last paragraph that climate change teaching in some schools ___. [A] agree to major public demands 同意重大的公众诉求 [B] reflects teachers' personal bias 反映出教师的个人偏见 [C] may misrepresent the energy sector 可能歪曲能源行业 [D] can be swayed by external forces 答案 D It is implied in the last paragraph that climate change teaching in some schools ___.最后一段暗示，一些学校的气候变化教学___。 [A] agree to major public demands同意重大的公众诉求 [B] reflects teachers' personal bias反映出教师的个人偏见 [C] may misrepresent the energy sector可能歪曲能源行业 [D] can be swayed by external forces 💡 考场思路末段：非官方教材传达偏激观点，包括自由意志智库和能源行业协会赞助的材料——说明气候教学可能被外部势力左右。

entries.title: Which of the following is true of New England?
entries.text: Which of the following is true of New England? [A] Its housing supply is at a very low level. [B] Its communities are in need of funding. 其社群亟需资金。 [C] Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly. 其房屋空置率正缓慢上升。 [D] Its home prices are under strict control. 其房价受到严格控制。 答案 A Which of the following is true of New England?以下哪项对新英格兰来说是正确的？ [A] Its housing supply is at a very low level. [B] Its communities are in need of funding.其社群亟需资金。 [C] Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly.其房屋空置率正缓慢上升。 [D] Its home prices are under strict control.其房价受到严格控制。 💡 考场思路第一段 record-high home prices and historically low inventory，第二段 vacancy rate dropped below 1%——住房供应极低。 逐项分析 [A] 住房供应极低 → 正确； [B] 社区需要资金 → 无中生有； [C] 空置率缓慢上升 → 与 dropped below 1% 相反； [D] 房价受严格控制 → 与 record-high 相反。 核心词汇 short-term rental 短租 inventory n. 库存 vacancy rate 空置率 crux n. 关键 bypass v. 绕过 mandate v. 强制要求

entries.title: The bill mentioned in Paragraph 2 was intended to ___.
entries.text: The bill mentioned in Paragraph 2 was intended to ___. [A] curb short-term rental speculation. 遏制短期租赁投机。 [B] ensure the supply of cheap housing 保障廉价住房的供应 [C] punish illegal dealings in housing 惩处住房领域的非法交易 [D] allow a free short-term rental market 答案 D The bill mentioned in Paragraph 2 was intended to ___.第2款中提到的法案旨在___。 [A] curb short-term rental speculation.遏制短期租赁投机。 [B] ensure the supply of cheap housing保障廉价住房的供应 [C] punish illegal dealings in housing惩处住房领域的非法交易 [D] allow a free short-term rental market 💡 考场思路第二段：bill 会"made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals"——即禁止各镇限制短租，也就是让短租市场自由。该 bill 被 voted against 了。

entries.title: Compared with Castle, Taylor is more likely to support ___.
entries.text: Compared with Castle, Taylor is more likely to support ___. [A] further investment in local tourism 对地方旅游的进一步投资 [B] an increase in affordable housing [C] strict management of real estate agents 对房地产经纪人的严格管理 [D] a favorable policy for short-term workers 一项有利于短期工的政策 答案 B Compared with Castle, Taylor is more likely to support ___.与城堡相比，泰勒更有可能支持___。 [A] further investment in local tourism对地方旅游的进一步投资 [B] an increase in affordable housing [C] strict management of real estate agents对房地产经纪人的严格管理 [D] a favorable policy for short-term workers一项有利于短期工的政策 💡 考场思路Taylor 说租赁住房供应处于危机水平，雇主难招人、工人难住房——他支持增加可负担住房。Castle 则强调短租对旅游业的好处。

entries.title: What does Horn emphasize in Paragraph 5?
entries.text: What does Horn emphasize in Paragraph 5? [A] The urgency to upgrade short-term rental facilities. 升级短期租赁设施的紧迫性。 [B] The efficient operation of the local housing market. 地方住房市场的高效运转。 [C] The necessity to stop developers from evading taxes. [D] The proper procedures for renting out spare houses. 出租闲置房屋的正当程序。 答案 C What does Horn emphasize in Paragraph 5?Horn在第5段中强调了什么？ [A] The urgency to upgrade short-term rental facilities.升级短期租赁设施的紧迫性。 [B] The efficient operation of the local housing market.地方住房市场的高效运转。 [C] The necessity to stop developers from evading taxes. [D] The proper procedures for renting out spare houses.出租闲置房屋的正当程序。 💡 考场思路第五段：Horn 说个人出租二套房没问题，但开发商搞大规模短租设施（实际是酒店）来 bypass taxes and regulations 就有问题——强调要阻止开发商逃税。

entries.title: Horn holds that imposing registration requirements is ___.
entries.text: Horn holds that imposing registration requirements is ___. [A] an irrational decision 一个不理性的决定 [B] an unfeasible proposal 一个不可行的提议 [C] an unnecessary measure 一项不必要的措施 [D] an inadequate solution 答案 D Horn holds that imposing registration requirements is ___.Horn认为，规定的注册要求是___。 [A] an irrational decision一个不理性的决定 [B] an unfeasible proposal一个不可行的提议 [C] an unnecessary measure一项不必要的措施 [D] an inadequate solution 💡 考场思路末段：Horn 说注册要求可能有帮助，但"解决问题的唯一方法是建更多住房"——即注册要求本身不够充分。

entries.title: The author mentions two books in Paragraph 1 to present ___.
entries.text: The author mentions two books in Paragraph 1 to present ___. [A] an ongoing conflict [B] an intellectual concept 一个智识概念 [C] a prevailing sentiment 一种普遍的情绪 [D] a literary phenomenon 一种文学现象 答案 A The author mentions two books in Paragraph 1 to present ___.作者在第1款中提到两本书来呈现___。 [A] an ongoing conflict [B] an intellectual concept一个智识概念 [C] a prevailing sentiment一种普遍的情绪 [D] a literary phenomenon一种文学现象 💡 考场思路两本书都由PRH出版，而PRH正与水石书店对峙——举例是为了呈现两家之间持续的冲突。 逐项分析 [A] 一场持续的冲突 → 正确； [B] 一个知识概念 → 无中生有； [C] 一种流行情绪 → 偷换； [D] 一种文学现象 → 偏离。 核心词汇 stand-off n. 对峙 credit limit 信用额度 boycott v. 抵制 merger n. 合并 consolidate v. 整合 plurality n. 多样性

entries.title: Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections?
entries.text: Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections? [A] to make them easily noticeable 使它们容易被注意到 [B] to comply with PRH's requirement 遵守PRH的要求 [C] to respond to PRH's business move [D] to arrange them in a systematic way 以系统的方式整理它们 答案 C Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections?为什么Waterstones商店将PRH图书退出相关部分？ [A] to make them easily noticeable使它们容易被注意到 [B] to comply with PRH's requirement遵守PRH的要求 [C] to respond to PRH's business move [D] to arrange them in a systematic way以系统的方式整理它们 💡 考场思路第二段：PRH先对水石书店设信用额度限制，水石书店才把书从显眼位置移走——这是对PRH商业举措的回应。

entries.title: What message did the spokesperson of Waterstones seem to convey?
entries.text: What message did the spokesperson of Waterstones seem to convey? [A] their customers remain royal [B] their credit limit will be removed 他们的信用额度将被取消 [C] their stock is underestimated 他们的股票被低估 [D] their book market is rather slack 他们的图书市场相当萧条 答案 A What message did the spokesperson of Waterstones seem to convey?Waterstones的发言人似乎传达了什么信息？ [A] their customers remain royal [B] their credit limit will be removed他们的信用额度将被取消 [C] their stock is underestimated他们的股票被低估 [D] their book market is rather slack他们的图书市场相当萧条 💡 考场思路发言人强调：门店异常繁忙、图书销售强劲、五月选书销量超2018年以来任何月份——意在传达顾客依然忠诚、生意很好。

entries.title: What can be one consequence of the current dispute?
entries.text: What can be one consequence of the current dispute? [A] Sales of books by mid-list writers fall considerably [B] Lesser-known PRH writers become the target of criticism 名气较小的PRH作家成为批评的靶子 [C] Waterstones staff hesitate to promote big-name author's books 水石书店员工不愿推销知名作家的书 [D] Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue 水石书店各分店收入大幅缩水 答案 A What can be one consequence of the current dispute?当前争议的一个后果是什么？ [A] Sales of books by mid-list writers fall considerably [B] Lesser-known PRH writers become the target of criticism名气较小的PRH作家成为批评的靶子 [C] Waterstones staff hesitate to promote big-name author's books水石书店员工不愿推销知名作家的书 [D] Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue水石书店各分店收入大幅缩水 💡 考场思路第四段：中间书目作者(mid-list authors)通常依靠水石书店员工热情推广不知名作家，他们会祈祷争端结束——说明中间书目作者的书销量会大跌。

entries.title: Which of the following statements best represents Lownie's view?
entries.text: Which of the following statements best represents Lownie's view? [A] Small publishers ought to stick together 小型出版商应当团结一致 [B] Big publishers will lose their dominance 大型出版商将失去主导地位 [C] The publishing industry is having a hard time 出版业正举步维艰 [D] The merger of publishers is a worrying trend 答案 D Which of the following statements best represents Lownie's view?以下哪项陈述最能代表Lownie的观点？ [A] Small publishers ought to stick together小型出版商应当团结一致 [B] Big publishers will lose their dominance大型出版商将失去主导地位 [C] The publishing industry is having a hard time出版业正举步维艰 [D] The merger of publishers is a worrying trend 💡 考场思路倒数第二段：洛尼说这是权力集中和卡特尔化的一部分，出版业需要多样性，最有趣的书来自小出版商——他担忧出版商合并这一趋势。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 1, the careers of scientists can be determined by ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 1, the careers of scientists can be determined by ___. [A] how many citations their works contain 其作品包含多少引用 [B] how many times their papers are cited [C] the prestige of the people they work with 他们所共事之人的声望 [D] the status they have in scientific circles 他们在科学界的地位 答案 B According to Paragraph 1, the careers of scientists can be determined by ___.根据第1款，科学家的职业生涯可以由___决定。 [A] how many citations their works contain其作品包含多少引用 [B] how many times their papers are cited [C] the prestige of the people they work with他们所共事之人的声望 [D] the status they have in scientific circles他们在科学界的地位 💡 考场思路第一段末："The careers of scientists... depend on... the citations attracted by these papers"——论文被引用的次数。注意区别：citations their works contain（自己文章里引用了别人多少次）vs citations attracted（自己文章被别人引用了多少次）。 逐项分析 [A] 自己作品包含多少引用 → 偷换，是被引用； [B] 论文被引用多少次 → 正确； [C] 合作者声望 → 未提及； [D] 科学界地位 → 是结果不是决定因素。 核心词汇 impact factor 影响因子 citation n. 引用 fraud n. 欺诈 plagiarism n. 抄袭 cartel n. 卡特尔/垄断联盟 insidious adj. 隐蔽的

entries.title: The support service consultancies tend to ___.
entries.text: The support service consultancies tend to ___. [A] recommended journals to their clients 向客户推荐期刊 [B] list citation patterns for their clients 为客户列出引文模式 [C] ask authors to include extra citation [D] advise contributors to cite each other 建议投稿者互相引用 答案 C The support service consultancies tend to ___.支持服务咨询公司倾向于___。 [A] recommended journals to their clients向客户推荐期刊 [B] list citation patterns for their clients为客户列出引文模式 [C] ask authors to include extra citation [D] advise contributors to cite each other建议投稿者互相引用 💡 考场思路第三段：咨询公司"advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles"——建议作者在文章中添加额外引用。

entries.title: The function of the milk cow journals is to ___.
entries.text: The function of the milk cow journals is to ___. [A] boost citation counts for certain authors [B] help scholars publish articles at low cost 帮助学者低成本发表文章 [C] instruct first time contributors 指导首次投稿者 [D] increase the readership of new journals 增加新期刊的读者群 答案 A The function of the milk cow journals is to ___.奶牛期刊的功能是___。 [A] boost citation counts for certain authors [B] help scholars publish articles at low cost帮助学者低成本发表文章 [C] instruct first time contributors指导首次投稿者 [D] increase the readership of new journals增加新期刊的读者群 💡 考场思路"奶牛期刊"(milk cow journals)即第三段中互相引用的期刊群体，功能是为特定作者虚增引用次数。

entries.title: What can be learned about Scopus from the last two paragraph?
entries.text: What can be learned about Scopus from the last two paragraph? [A] It fosters competition among citation providers 它促进了引文提供方之间的竞争 [B] It has the capability to identify suspicious citation [C] It hinders the growth of international journals 它阻碍了国际期刊的发展 [D] It is established to prevent citation manipulation 它的设立是为了防止引用操纵 答案 B What can be learned about Scopus from the last two paragraph?从最后两段中可以学到什么关于Scopus的信息？ [A] It fosters competition among citation providers它促进了引文提供方之间的竞争 [B] It has the capability to identify suspicious citation [C] It hinders the growth of international journals它阻碍了国际期刊的发展 [D] It is established to prevent citation manipulation它的设立是为了防止引用操纵 💡 考场思路第三段提到2016年开发了算法识别可疑引用模式，末段说Scopus收录大量新国际期刊、问题猖獗——反向推断Scopus有能力识别可疑引用（否则不会成为目标标准）。

entries.title: What should an author do to deal with citation manipulation?
entries.text: What should an author do to deal with citation manipulation? [A] Take legal action 采取法律行动 [B] Demand an apology 要求道歉 [C] Seek professional advice 寻求专业建议 [D] Reveal their misconduct 答案 D What should an author do to deal with citation manipulation?作者应该如何处理引文操纵？ [A] Take legal action采取法律行动 [B] Demand an apology要求道歉 [C] Seek professional advice寻求专业建议 [D] Reveal their misconduct 💡 考场思路全文揭露引用操纵现象——作者应对之道就是揭露这种不当行为(reveal misconduct)。

entries.title: ___ the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential…
entries.text: ___ the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential… [A] Through 通过 [B] Despite 尽管 [C] Besides 此外 [D] Without 不需要 答案 D Without ___ the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential…___需要触摸才能打开或关闭，自动门是必不可少的…… [A] Through 通过 [B] Despite 尽管 [C] Besides 此外 [D] Without 不需要 💡 考场思路看到 automatic doors 这个词，第一反应是"自动=不用手碰"。空格后 the need to be touched（被触碰的需求），自动门之所以叫自动门，就是因为它"不需要"被触碰。这是对自动门基本定义的考查。 逐项排除 [A] Through the need…"通过需要被触碰"——语义不通，自动门不是通过触碰来工作的； [B] Despite the need…"尽管需要被触碰"——这与自动门特性完全相反； [C] Besides the need…"除了需要被触碰之外还……"——暗示自动门也需要触碰，错； [D] Without the need…"不需要被触碰"——完美对应 automatic 的定义。 语法点睛逗号前面是介词短语作状语，主句是 automatic doors are essential…。Without 引导的介词短语表"没有……的情况下"，是完形常考的逻辑开头。

entries.title: The Romans buried the nails probably for the sake of ___.
entries.text: The Romans buried the nails probably for the sake of ___. [A] saving them for future use 将它们保存以备将来使用 [B] keeping them from rusting 防止它们生锈 [C] letting them grow in value 让它们增值 [D] hiding them from the locals 答案 D The Romans buried the nails probably for the sake of ___.罗马人埋钉子可能是为了___。 [A] saving them for future use将它们保存以备将来使用 [B] keeping them from rusting防止它们生锈 [C] letting them grow in value让它们增值 [D] hiding them from the locals 💡 考场思路题干 Romans buried the nails 定位第二段。关键句："they didn't want the local Caledonians getting their hands on 10 tons of weapon-grade iron"——不想让当地人拿到武器级铁。get their hands on = 得到。 逐项分析 [A] 留着以后用 → 原文说撤退匆忙，不是存起来； [B] 防止生锈 → 无中生有； [C] 让它们升值 → 无中生有； [D] 藏起来不让当地人拿到 → 正确，对应 didn't want...getting their hands on。 核心词汇 weapon-grade adj. 武器级的 hoard n. 窖藏 withdrawal n. 撤退 millennia n. 千年（复数） get one's hands on 弄到手 rushed adj. 匆忙的

entries.title: The example of early 17th-century Virginians is used to ___.
entries.text: The example of early 17th-century Virginians is used to ___. [A] highlight the thriftiness of early American colonists 凸显早期美洲殖民者的节俭 [B] illustrate the high status of blacksmiths in that period 展现那一时期铁匠的崇高地位 [C] contrast the attitudes of different civilisations towards nails 对比不同文明对钉子的态度 [D] show the preciousness of nail-making technology at that time 答案 D The example of early 17th-century Virginians is used to ___.17世纪初弗吉尼亚人的例子被用来___。 [A] highlight the thriftiness of early American colonists凸显早期美洲殖民者的节俭 [B] illustrate the high status of blacksmiths in that period展现那一时期铁匠的崇高地位 [C] contrast the attitudes of different civilisations towards nails对比不同文明对钉子的态度 [D] show the preciousness of nail-making technology at that time 💡 考场思路例证题答案=例子前后的论点句。例子后一句："burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was"——烧掉房子只为回收钉子，说明制钉技术有多宝贵。 逐项分析 [A] 夸殖民者节俭 → 例子不是为了夸节俭； [B] 说铁匠地位高 → 过度推断； [C] 对比不同文明态度 → 只有一个例子，没有对比； [D] 说明制钉技术珍贵 → 正确，scarce, costly, valuable = preciousness。 题型铁律例证题（be used to / is mentioned to）答案永远不在例子本身，而在例子前后的论点句。

entries.title: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?
entries.text: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s? [A] Increased productivity. [B] Wider use of new energies. 新能源的更广泛应用。 [C] Fiercer market competition. 更激烈的市场竞争。 [D] Reduced cost of raw materials. 原材料成本降低。 答案 A What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?在19世纪后期之后，什么在降低指甲价格方面发挥了主要作用？ [A] Increased productivity. [B] Wider use of new energies.新能源的更广泛应用。 [C] Fiercer market competition.更激烈的市场竞争。 [D] Reduced cost of raw materials.原材料成本降低。 💡 考场思路定位第四段。原文："most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails"——主要功劳在于更高效的生产方法。more efficient ways = increased productivity。 逐项分析 [A] 生产率提高 → 正确； [B] 新能源 → 原文 cheaper energy 只是 partly； [C] 市场竞争 → 未提及； [D] 原材料降价 → cheaper iron 也只是 partly，不是 major role。

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that nails ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that nails ___. [A] have undergone many technological improvements 经历了诸多技术改进 [B] have remained basically the same since Roman times [C] are less studied than other everyday products 比其他日常用品研究得少 [D] are one of the world's most significant inventions 是世界上最重要的发明之一 答案 B It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that nails ___.从第5段可以了解到，钉子___。 [A] have undergone many technological improvements经历了诸多技术改进 [B] have remained basically the same since Roman times [C] are less studied than other everyday products比其他日常用品研究得少 [D] are one of the world's most significant inventions是世界上最重要的发明之一 💡 考场思路第五段："Roman nails are still clearly nails"——罗马钉子至今还是钉子，基本没变。 逐项分析 [A] 经历很多改进 → 与 haven't changed much 相反； [B] 自罗马时代基本没变 → 正确； [C] 研究少 → 无中生有； [D] 最重要发明之一 → 过度拔高。

entries.title: Which of the following best summarises the last two paragraphs?
entries.text: Which of the following best summarises the last two paragraphs? [A] Cheap technologies bring about revolutionary change. [B] Technological innovation is integral to economic success. 技术创新对经济成功不可或缺。 [C] Technology defines people's understanding of the world. 技术定义了人们对世界的理解。 [D] Sophisticated technologies develop from small inventions. 精妙的技术源于小发明。 答案 A Which of the following best summarises the last two paragraphs?以下哪项最能概括最后两段？ [A] Cheap technologies bring about revolutionary change. [B] Technological innovation is integral to economic success.技术创新对经济成功不可或缺。 [C] Technology defines people's understanding of the world.技术定义了人们对世界的理解。 [D] Sophisticated technologies develop from small inventions.精妙的技术源于小发明。 💡 考场思路倒数第二段末句是全文论点："it's the cheap technologies that change the world"——廉价技术改变世界。最后一段用古腾堡印刷机和太阳能板举例。 逐项分析 [A] 廉价技术带来革命性变化 → 正确，必须同时包含 cheap + change the world； [B] 技术创新对经济成功不可或缺 → 偏离； [C] 技术定义世界观 → 无中生有； [D] 复杂技术从小发明发展 → 与文意相反。 核心词汇 hype n. 大肆宣传 enchantingly adv. 迷人地 be poised to 准备就绪 niche uses 小众用途

entries.title: According to the first two paragraphs, alloparenting refers to the practice of _
entries.text: According to the first two paragraphs, alloparenting refers to the practice of ___. [A] sharing child care among community members [B] assigning babies to specific adult caregivers 将婴儿分配给特定的成人照料者 [C] teaching parenting details to older children 向大孩子讲授育儿细节 [D] carrying infants around by their parents 由父母随身抱着婴儿 答案 A According to the first two paragraphs, alloparenting refers to the practice of ___.根据前两段，异教育是指___的做法。 [A] sharing child care among community members [B] assigning babies to specific adult caregivers将婴儿分配给特定的成人照料者 [C] teaching parenting details to older children向大孩子讲授育儿细节 [D] carrying infants around by their parents由父母随身抱着婴儿 💡 考场思路alloparenting 出现在第二段，但定义在第一段：each child is cared for by many adults——每个孩子由很多成年人共同照料。 逐项分析 [A] 社区成员共同分担育儿 → 正确； [B] 指定给特定成年人 → 与 many adults 矛盾； [C] 教大孩子育儿 → 片面； [D] 父母背婴儿 → 这是 baby-wearing，不是 alloparenting。

entries.title: The scheme in Germany is mentioned to illustrate ___.
entries.text: The scheme in Germany is mentioned to illustrate ___. [A] an attempt to facilitate intergenerational communication 一次促进代际沟通的努力 [B] an approach to integrating alloparenting into western society [C] the conventional parenting style in western culture 西方文化中的传统育儿方式 [D] the differences between western and African ways of living 西方与非洲生活方式的差异 答案 B The scheme in Germany is mentioned to illustrate ___.提到德国的方案是为了说明___。 [A] an attempt to facilitate intergenerational communication一次促进代际沟通的努力 [B] an approach to integrating alloparenting into western society [C] the conventional parenting style in western culture西方文化中的传统育儿方式 [D] the differences between western and African ways of living西方与非洲生活方式的差异 💡 考场思路第三段论点句："there are ways to incorporate them into western life"——有办法把共同育儿融入西方生活。德国案例就是例子。 逐项分析 [A] 促进代际交流 → 这是案例表面内容； [B] 将共同育儿融入西方社会的方法 → 正确； [C] 西方传统育儿方式 → 与原文相反，这是新尝试； [D] 西方与非洲生活方式差异 → 不是为了对比。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, the "intensive mothering narrative" ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, the "intensive mothering narrative" ___. [A] alleviates parenting pressures 缓解育儿压力。 [B] considers family relationships 考量家庭关系 [C] results in the child-centered family 导致了以孩子为中心的家庭 [D] departs from the course of evolution 答案 D According to Paragraph 4, the "intensive mothering narrative" ___.根据第4段， “密集的育儿叙事” ___。 [A] alleviates parenting pressures缓解育儿压力。 [B] considers family relationships考量家庭关系 [C] results in the child-centered family导致了以孩子为中心的家庭 [D] departs from the course of evolution 💡 考场思路第四段说西方核心家庭"broke with evolutionary history"——打破进化史，即偏离进化进程。 逐项分析 [A] 缓解育儿压力 → 与 maternal exhaustion 相反； [B] 考虑家庭关系 → 无中生有； [C] 导致以孩子为中心 → 未提及； [D] 偏离进化进程 → 正确，broke with evolutionary history。

[A] Instructive teaching: a dilemma for anxious parents 启发式教学：焦虑父母的困境 [B] For a happier family, learn from the hunter-gatherers [C] Mixed-age playgroup, a better choice for lonely children 混龄游戏小组：孤独儿童更好的选择 [D] Tracing the history of parenting: from Africa to Europe 追溯育儿史：从非洲到欧洲 答案 B Which of the following would be the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Instructive teaching: a dilemma for anxious parents启发式教学：焦虑父母的困境 [B] For a happier family, learn from the hunter-gatherers [C] Mixed-age playgroup, a better choice for lonely children混龄游戏小组：孤独儿童更好的选择 [D] Tracing the history of parenting: from Africa to Europe追溯育儿史：从非洲到欧洲 💡 考场思路全文首句即主旨：从非洲狩猎采集者那里获得的育儿秘诀可能是养出更快乐孩子的关键。

[C] He attracts admiration from other illustrators. 他吸引了其他插画师的钦佩。 [D] He specializes in classical painting digitalization. 他专攻古典绘画的数字化。 答案 B What can be learned about Rutkowski from the first two paragraphs?从前两段中可以学到什么关于Rutkowski的信息？ [A] He is enthusiastic about using AI models.他热衷于使用AI模型。 [B] He is popular with users of an AI art generator. [C] He attracts admiration from other illustrators.他吸引了其他插画师的钦佩。 [D] He specializes in classical painting digitalization.他专攻古典绘画的数字化。 💡 考场思路第二段说他的风格是Stable Diffusion最常用提示词之一，说明他在AI生成器用户中很受欢迎。 逐项分析 [A] 他热衷于用AI → 后文说他concerning，态度转变； [B] 在AI艺术生成器用户中受欢迎 → 正确； [C] 受其他画家钦佩 → 未提及； [D] 专注古典绘画数字化 → 偷换，他uses classical painting styles。

entries.title: The problem with open-source AI art generators is that they ___.
entries.text: The problem with open-source AI art generators is that they ___. [A] lack flexibility in responding to prompts 在应对提示时缺乏灵活性 [B] produce artworks in unpredictable styles 以不可预测的风格创作艺术品 [C] make unauthorized use of online images [D] collect user information without consent 在未经同意的情况下收集用户信息 答案 C The problem with open-source AI art generators is that they ___.开源AI艺术生成器的问题在于它们___。 [A] lack flexibility in responding to prompts在应对提示时缺乏灵活性 [B] produce artworks in unpredictable styles以不可预测的风格创作艺术品 [C] make unauthorized use of online images [D] collect user information without consent在未经同意的情况下收集用户信息 💡 考场思路第三段直接说"built by scraping images from the Internet, without artist consent"——未经同意抓取网络图片。

entries.title: After searching online, Rutkowski found ___.
entries.text: After searching online, Rutkowski found ___. entries.title: According to Ortiz, AI companies are advised to ___.

entries.text: They sometimes travel more than sixty miles to find food or water, and are very good at working out where other elephants are—even when they are out of sight. They sometimes travel more than sixty miles to find food or water, and are very good at working out where other elephants are—even when they are out of sight. 它们有时跋涉六十多英里寻找食物或水，并且非常善于判断其他大象的位置——即使那些大象不在视线范围内。 采分点① travel more than sixty miles 跋涉六十多英里；② work out 判断/弄清楚；③ out of sight 视线之外。

entries.text: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic: each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature. The experiment showed that elephants may well use smell to identify patches of trees that are good to eat, and secondly to assess the quality of the trees within each patch. 实验表明，大象很可能利用嗅觉来识别哪些树林值得取食，其次还能评估每片树林中树木的质量。 采分点① may well 很可能；② patches of trees 成片树林；③ assess 评估。

entries.title: Your international student friend Paul is going to give an oral report on ancien
entries.text: Your international student friend Paul is going to give an oral report on ancient Chinese scientists but does not know how to prepare it. Write an email to offer him some help. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 建议信 原题指令 Directions Your international student friend Paul is going to give an oral report on ancient Chinese scientists but does not know how to prepare it. Write an email to offer him some help. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. 【译文】你的留学生朋友保罗准备做一个关于中国古代科学家的口头报告，却不知如何准备。写一封电子邮件为他提供帮助。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。 题目 国际学生Paul要做关于中国古代科学家的口头报告，不知如何准备，写邮件求助。约100词，落款Li Ming。 审题 ① 格式：邮件；② 语气：友好乐于助人；③ 内容：2-3条具体建议。 参考范文 Dear Paul, I was delighted to receive your email and would like to offer some practical advice on preparing your oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist. First, I suggest you choose Bi Sheng, the inventor of movable-type printing, whose story is both landmark and compelling. Second, consult authoritative sources such as Joseph Needham's works, which are reliable and accessible. Finally, rehearse your presentation in front of a mirror or record yourself, so you can polish both your content and delivery. I hope these suggestions help. Wish you a brilliant performance! Yours sincerely, L
